contentBlocks.text: Inani Lesibonelelo Nohlelo Lokukhokha

Isibonelelo se-SRD singu-R370 ngenyanga. Izinkokhelo zenziwa phakathi komhla wama-25 nosuku lokugcina lwenyanga ngayinye. Ngokungafani nezinye izibonelelo ze-SASSA, isibonelelo se-SRD asinaso usuku olulodwa oluhleliwe lokukhokha — izinkokhelo zikhishwa ngokuqhubekayo kusukela ngomhla wama-25. Abanye abatholi besibonelelo bangathola inkhokho kusenesikhathi noma kamuva kuleli windi kuye ngebhange labo noma indlela abakhetha ukuyithatha ngayo.

contentBlocks.text: Indlela Yokufaka Isicelo Sesibonelelo Se-SRD R370

Ukufaka isicelo sesibonelelo se-SRD kwenziwa ngokugcwele ku-inthanethi — akudingeki uhambe uye ehhovisi le-SASSA ukuze ufake isicelo. Kunezindlela ezimbili zokufaka isicelo. Uma ubhekana nobunzima nohlelo loku-inthanethi, i-SASSA inamaziko amahhala aziwayo (call centres) nama-kiosk okuzisiza lapho abasebenzi abangakusiza khona ukuba ufake isicelo ubuso nobuso — bheka umhlahlandlela wethu wezinkonzo zocingo namakioski ukuze uthole imininingwane ephelele.

contentBlocks.text: Indlela 2: I-WhatsApp

Ungafaka isicelo nge-WhatsApp ye-SASSA. Gcina u-082 046 8553 kuma-contact wakho ocingweni, thumela amagama athi 'SASSA' ukuze uqale ingxoxo, bese ulandela imiyalelo emenyini ukuze uthumele isicelo esisha. Lolu hlelo lwe-WhatsApp simahla kwezinye izinethiwekhi eziningi zaseNingizimu Afrika.

contentBlocks.text: Indlela Yokuhlola Isimo Sakho Se-SRD

Ungabheka isimo sesibonelelo sakho se-SRD ngezindlela eziningi. Indlela evame kakhulu yiphaneli loku-inthanethi eliku-srd.sassa.gov.za — faka inombolo yakho yomazisi kanye nenombolo yocingo esetshenziswe ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo, qinisekisa nge-OTP, bese kuvela i-interface yakho yesimo. Ungabheka nge-WhatsApp (082 046 8553), nge-USSD (*134*7737#), noma ngokuvakashela ihhovisi le-SASSA. Ukuze uthole umhlahlandlela ophelele, bheka ikhasi lethu lokubheka isimo.

contentBlocks.text: Indlela Yokufaka Isikhalazo Ngesibonelelo Se-SRD Esinqatshiwe

Uma isibonelelo sakho se-SRD sinqatshwa noma yinyiphi inyanga, unelungelo lokufaka isikhalazo. Izikhalazo ziphethwe yi-Independent Tribunal for Social Assistance Appeals (ITSAA), hhayi ngu-SASSA ngokwayo. Unezinsuku ezingama-30 kusukela ngosuku lokwaliwa ukuthi uthumele isikhalazo sakho (iphaneli ye-ITSAA yamukela izikhalazo kuze kube izinsuku ezingama-90). Ngenxa yokuthi inyanga ngayinye ihlolwa ngokwehlukana, kumele ufake isikhalazo ngenyanga ngayinye enqatshiwe.

contentBlocks.text: Izindlela Zokukhokha

Ungathola isibonelelo sakho se-SRD ngezindlela ezimbili: ukudluliselwa kwemali ngqo (EFT) kuya ekhawuntini yakho yasebhange, noma nge-Cash Send (ukuthathwa ezitolo) ezitolo ezibambiqhaza. Ungashintsha phakathi kwalezi zindlela nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngephaneli le-SRD. Ushintsho luba nokubaluleka kusukela ngolunye uhlangothi oluzayo.

contentBlocks.title: Akukho Akhawunti Yasebhange Edingekayo
contentBlocks.text: Awudingi i-akhawunti yasebhange ukuze uthole isibonelelo se-SRD. Khetha 'Cash Send' njengendlela yakho yokukhokha bese uthola isibonelelo sakho kunoma yisiphi isitolo se-Pick n Pay, i-Shoprite, i-Boxer, i-Checkers, noma i-Usave usebenzisa i-voucher yokuthunyelwa ku-SMS kwakho.
Ubani Ofanelekela Isibonelelo Se-SRD R370 — Ngokuningiliziwe

Isibonelelo se-SRD R370 sivulelekile eqenjini elibanzi labantu abahlala eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa imithetho yokuthi ngubani obalwa 'njengofanelekayo' iqine kunalokho abaningi abakucabangayo. I-SASSA kumele iqinisekise kokubili umazisi wakho nesimo sakho sokuhlala ngokuqhathanisa namarekhodi asemthethweni kahulumeni ngaphambi kokuba noma yimuphi umkhawulo wokukhokha ugunyazwe. Lesi sibonelelo senzelwe abantu abangenayo ngempela imali engenayo noma ezinye izinhlobo zokusekwa nguhulumeni, ngakho lo mkhakha uhlola isicelo ngasinye ngokuqhathanisa nezizindalwazi ezimbalwa zikazwelonke. Ukuhlangabezana nesidingo somunye noma sombili akwanele — kumele uhlangabezane nazo zonke ngasikhathi sinye, futhi kumele uqhubeke uhlangabezana nazo njalo ngenyanga.
Ubuzwe, ububhula, nesimo sokuhlala

items: Izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ezinomazisi osemthenthefu oneziphathimandla eziyi-13.
Izihlali zomuntu wonke ezingapheli ezinephasi lokuqhubeka lokuphila laseNingizimu Afrika.
Ababaleki ababhaliswe ngokusemthenthefu ohlelweni loMnyango Wezindaba Zangaphakathi.
Abafuna ukukhosela nabanama-permit akhethekile, abafaka izicelo basebenzise izinombolo zamaphepha abo emvume esikhundleni somazisi waseNingizimu Afrika.
Kumele ube khona ngokomzimba futhi uhlale ngokujwayelekile eNingizimu Afrika. Lesi sibonelelo asitholakali kubantu abahlala ngaphandle kwezwe.

contentBlocks.text: Umthetho weminyaka: 18 kuya ku-59

Kumele ube neminyaka okungenani engu-18 futhi ungakafiki eminyakeni engu-60. Isibonelelo se-SRD saklanywa njengesikhawu sokusekwa kubantu abadala abasezinkinganeni zokusebenza abangena kwezinye izigaba zezibonelelo. Uma uneminyaka engu-60 noma ngaphezulu, kumele ufake isicelo se-Older Person's Grant esikhundleni, okuyisibonelelo esingapheli esinenani (eliphakeme) laso kanye nokuhlolwa kwezimali okuhlukile. Uma uneminyaka engaphansi kuka-18, awukwazi ukuthola isibonelelo se-SRD ngegama lakho; usizo lwezingane luza ngeChild Support Grant ekhokhelwa umnakekeli. Ukubheka kweminyaka kusebenza ngokuzenzekelayo kusetshenziswa usuku lwakho lokuzalwa kurejista ye-Home Affairs, ngakho akudingeki ukuthi uthumele ubufakazi bokuthi uneminyaka engakanani ngokwehlukana.
Umholo nokuhlolwa kwezimali kuka-R624

Umthetho obaluleke kakhulu umthetho wokuhlolwa kwemali engenayo (means test). Ukuze uthole isibonelelo se-SRD, umholo wakho wanyanga zonke owahloliwe kumele ube ngu-R624 noma ngaphansi. Leli khawulu iyilo inani i-SASSA elibheka ngalo i-akhawunti yakho yasebhange namanye amarekhodi akho njalo ngenyanga. Uma amadiphozithi ase-akhawuntini yakho ebonisa ukuthi uthola okungaphezu kuka-R624 ngenyanga ethile, isimiso sizokumaka njengonethe 'umthombo wemali ongomunye' bese yenqaba leyo nyanga. Akunandaba ukuthi imali iyisibholo, isipho, inkokhelo ye-stokvel, noma ukudluliselwa kanye kwemali — okubalulekile inani elenza ise-akhawuntini yakho ngokuqhathanisa nomkhawulo. Ukuhlolwa kubheka isimo sakho sakho wezimali, hhayi ukusebenza kwekhaya lakho lilonke, kodwa noma yimuphi umbe oyose-akhawuntini yakho usabalwa etotal yuqu yakho.

contentBlocks.title: Okushiwo 'umholo' lapha
contentBlocks.text: I-SASSA ibheka imali engena e-akhawuntini yakho yasebhange, hhayi nje umsebenzi osemthethweni. Imali engenayo engakahleleki, ukusekwa okujwayelekile okuvela emndenini, ngisho namadiphozithi amakhulu enza kanye kungathinta ukuhlolwa kwakho. Uma idiphozithi ingesiyo imali engenayo ngempela, ungase udinge ukuyichaza ngesikhathi sokufaka isikhalazo ngesifungo esibhaliwe.
Umholo nokusekwa okwenze ungafaneleki

items: Isibholo noma umholo ojwayelekile oqhubeka nge-PAYE (ubusebenza ngokusemthenthefu).
Izinkokhelo ze-UIF (Umkhakha Womshwalense Wokungasebenzi) ezisebenzayo — isib., ngemva kokucutshulwa emsebenzi.
Uxhaso lwe-NSFAS (Uhlelo Lukazwelonke Losizo Lwezimali Lwabafundi) ngenkathi ubhalisile njengomfundi.
Noma yisiphi esinye isibonelelo se-SASSA esikhokhelwa wena ngqo, ngaphandle kokukodwa okukhethekile: isibonelelo seChild Support Grant esikhokhelwa ingane yakho asikwenzi ungafaneleki.
Ukuhlala esikhungweni esixhaswa nguhulumeni njengejele, isikhungo sokunakekela kahulumeni, noma ikhaya elifanayo elixhaswa nguhulumeni.

contentBlocks.text: Izimo ezikhethekile: abafundi, abasebenzi begig nezabasebenza emakhaya

Abafundi bayindawo ejwayele ukudidisa. Uma uthola uxhaso lwe-NSFAS, awufaneleki ukuthola isibonelelo se-SRD ngesikhathi leso uxhaso lwale, ngoba i-NSFAS ibalwa njengokusekwa nguhulumeni kwezimali. Abafundi ANGATHOLI uxhaso lwe-NSFAS futhi abangenawo omunye umholo basengafaneleka, inqobo nje uma umholo wabo wanyanga zonke uhlala ungu-R624 noma ngaphansi. Ama-bursary avela ezinkampanini ezizimele noma emindenini awafani ne-NSFAS, kodwa noma iyiphi idiphozithi evamile ibalwa ekuhlolweni kwemali engenayo, ngakho i-bursary yezinkampani ezizimele ekukhuphulela ngenhla komkhawulo izothinta umphumela wakho.

Abasebenzi begig (gig workers) nabezinkonzo ezikhawulelwe (abashayeli bezimoto zokuqasha, abahambisa izimpahla ngamabhayisikili, abasebenza ngokuzimela, nabosebeni lusuku) bangafaneleka KUPHELA uma inani eliphelele abalitholayo ngenyanga lingaphansi kuka-R624 noma lingu-R624. Ngenxa yokuthi umholo wegig awuvamile, isimo sakho singashintsha phakathi kokuthi 'Isemukelwe' nokuthi 'Sinqatshiwe' kusukela kwelinye inyanga kuye kwelinye lapho amadiphozithi eshintshana. Gcina umsebenzi wakho wamabhange uhlanze kangangokunokwenzeka futhi uhlale ulungele ukufaka isikhalazo ngezinyanga lapho isimo sakho sangempela seholo eliphansi siphawulwe ngokungafanele. Inyanga eyodwa enhle ngenhla komkhawulo ngeke ikukhanshele isibonelelo unomphela — ithinta kuphela leyo nyanga ethile.

Abasebenzi basekhaya nabanye abasebenza isikhathi esingatolakali kahle bafaneleka kuphela uma imali abayitholayo ingaphansi komkhawulo ka-R624 FUTHI bangabhaliselanga ku-PAYE. Uma umqashi wakho ekukhokha ngokusemthenthefu ngeslipi yemuholo ne-PAYE, ngokuvamile uthathwa njengosebenza futhi ngeke ufanelekele leyo nyanga. Uma wenza umsebenzi ngezikhathi ezithile, okhokhelwa kancane kakhulu ongagcini wena ngezansi kuka-R624, ungafaneleka, kodwa izinhlolo zasebhange ezanyanga zonke zisho ukuthi kumele ngempela uwele ngaphansi komkhawulo. Umsebenzi wasekhaya ongakahlelekile okhokhelwa ngokheshi ongaze ufike e-akhawuntini yakho yasebhange awubonwa yi-SASSA, kodwa kumele namanje umemezele isimo sakho sokuba ngumsebenzi ngokuqotho.
Ukuhlolwa Kwezimali Kuchaziwe, Ngemizekelo Esetshenzisiwe

Ukuhlolwa kwezimali kumane nje kuyindlela ye-SASSA yokuphendula umbuzo owodwa: 'Ngabe lo muntu unemali enganele yokuphila ngaphandle kwalesi sibonelelo?' Ukuhlolwa kwenziwa ngokuzenzekelayo. Nyanga zonke, i-SASSA ithola idatha yemali engenayo bese iyiqhathanisa nomkhawulo ka-R624. Ngezansi kunezibonelo ezingokoqobo zokuthi ukuhlolwa kusebenza kanjani. Lezi izifanekiso zokusiza uqonde umqondo — isimo sakho sokwakho sihlolwa ngamarekhodi akho angempela ebhange nasezizindalwazini, futhi izimo eziyinkimbinkimbi (njengediphozithi enkulu kodwa engewona umholo) ziphethwa enqubweni yokufaka isikhalazo kunokuba ziphethwe ekuhlaseleni kokuqala.

Awufaneleki — i-UIF iyimali engenayo enqikaza ukufaneleka.

contentBlocks.title: Ukhawu Lungabuyekezwa
contentBlocks.text: Inani lika-R624 libonisa izinga lokuhlolwa kwezimali kwamanje elimisiwe yi-SASSA. Uhulumeni angase alungise leli nani ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Hlala ubheka leli nani 'njengekhawulu lakamuva elisemthenthefu' bese uqinisekisa ku-srd.sassa.gov.za uma ungaqiniseki.

Indlela idatha ye-SARS esetshenziswa ngayo: I-SASSA ayinqumi nje ukuthi umholo wakho ungakanani. Ithola amafayela okuqinisekisa avela ku-South African Revenue Service (SARS), uMnyango Wezindaba Zangaphakathi, uhlelo lwe-UIF, naku-NSFAS. Uma i-SARS ibonisa ukuthi ubhalisile ku-PAYE noma wamemezela umholo womsebenzi ongenhla komkhawulo, isimiso sizokwenqaba. Yikho lokhu kusho ukuthi ukuqiniseka ukuthi amarekhodi akho entela nowomsebenzi aze afike kahle kubalulekile — ukubhaliswa okudala noma okungalungile komqashi kungavimba isibonelelo sakho ngokungalungile kuze kube umkhawulo ulungiswa ne-SARS. Uma ukholelwa ukuthi umqashi wakho wangaphambili usakubhala njengomsebenzi, ungase udinge ukuthi ukuxazulule ne-SARS bese ufaka isikhalazo ngezinyanga ezithintekayo.
Indlela Yokufaka Isicelo Sesibonelelo Se-SRD Isinyathelo Ngesinyathelo (Ku-Inthanethi)

Ukufaka isicelo ku-inthanethi iyindlela esheshayo nemahhala, futhi imahhala ngokuphelele. Akudingeki ukuthi ukhokhe muntu, futhi akudingeki uhambe uye ehhovisi. Ngaphambi kokuqala, yiba nomazisi wakho (noma inombolo yephasi) kanye nomakhalekhukhwini ogxilile ngegama lakho, kanye nemininingwane yakho yasebhange uma ufuna ukukhokhelwa nge-EFT. Ukuhamba okulandelayo ngezansi kunweba izinyathelo eziyisisekelo ngemininingwane esebenzayo abafaki bezicelo abaningi abayiphuthayo. Ngokubuka okuhlukanisiwe futhi okuhleliwe ungaqala futhi uthole umhlahlandlela oyinhloko wokufaka isicelo se-SRD oxhunyaniswe ngezansi.

steps.title: Vula iphaneli elisemthenthefu
steps.description: Vakashela i-srd.sassa.gov.za. Lona ukuphela kwesayithi elisemthenthefu lokufaka isicelo se-SRD. Gcina isikhonkwane futhi gwema ukuqasha 'abasebenzi' bangaphandle abathembisa ukufaka isicelo egameni lakho.

steps.title: Qala isicelo esisha
steps.description: Skrolela isigaba sokufaka isicelo sezikhodi zamazisi zaseNingizimu Afrika (noma isigaba esihlukile sabafuna ukukhosela/abanama-permit akhethekile). Faka inombolo yakho yomazisi enezinamba eziyi-13.

steps.title: Qinisekisa inombolo yakho yocingo
steps.description: Faka inombolo yocingo ebhaliswe ngegama lakho. I-SASSA ithumela i-PIN yenyakatho eyodwa (OTP) nge-SMS. Bhala ukuze ubonise ukuthi ulawula leyo nombolo. Ungaze wabelane ngale OTP nanoma ngubani.

steps.title: Bhala imininingwane yakho yomuntu
steps.description: Qinisekisa igama lakho, isibongo, nosuku lokuzalwa ngokufana ncamashi nokubonakala kumazisi wakho. Ukungafani ne-Home Affairs kuyisizathu esikhulu sokuphuza nezinhlolo zokuqinisekisa ezehluleka.

steps.title: Khetha indlela yakho yokukhokha
steps.description: Khetha i-akhawunti yasebhange (bhala inombolo yekhawunti, igatsha, nebhange) noma I-Cash Send / ukuthatha ezitolo. I-akhawunti kumele ibe ngeyakho.

steps.title: Yamukela izimemezelo
steps.description: Maka amabhokisi aqinisekisa ukuthi uhlangabezana nezidingo: awusebenzi, awukho omunye umhlawulo, awukho i-UIF/NSFAS, umholo ungu-R624 noma ngaphansi, futhi awukho esikhungweni sikahulumeni.

steps.title: Thumela bese ugcina inkomba yakho
steps.description: Thumela ifomu. Uthola i-SMS eqinisekisa ukuthi itholiwe kanye nenkomba yakho yokubheka isicelo. Yigcine ukuze usebenze ngayo phambili nokubheka isimo.

contentBlocks.title: Kumahhala futhi kuyazisebenzela
contentBlocks.text: Ukufaka isicelo ku-inthanethi kumahhala. Uma ungakwazi ukusebenzisa iwebhusayithi, ungafaka isicelo ngomugqa we-WhatsApp we-SASSA noma uvakashele ihhovisi le-SASSA noma i-kiosk yosizo ngaphandle kwezindleko. Akekho ongokomthetho ozokubiza imali ukuze ufake isicelo.
Indlela Yokufaka Isicelo Ngomugqa We-WhatsApp We-SASSA

Uma ungenawo ukufinyelela okulula kubrowser, noma umane uthanda ukusebenzisa umakhalekhukhwini wakho, ungawuqeda wonke umsebenzi wokufaka isicelo ku-WhatsApp. Lolu hlelo lunikezwa yi-SASSA kwinombolo 082 046 8553 futhi luyimahhala kwezinye izinethiwekhi eziningi zaseNingizimu Afrika. I-WhatsApp isebenzisa izinhlolo ezifanayo futhi ifinyelela umphumela ofanayo nalowo wewebhusayithi.

steps.title: Gcina inombolo
steps.description: Engeza u-082 046 8553 kuma-contact wakho njengo 'SASSA SRD'.

steps.title: Qala ingxoxo
steps.description: Vula i-WhatsApp, thumela umyalezo 'SASSA' (noma 'HI') ku-082 046 8553, bese uthumela.

steps.title: Khetha inketho yokufaka isicelo
steps.description: Landa imenyu yezimpendulo. Khetha inketho yokufaka isicelo esisha se-SRD (ngokuvamile ngokuphendula ngenombolo noma ngegama elihambisanayo).

steps.title: Faka umazisi wakho nemininingwane
steps.description: Lapho ucelwa, bhala inombolo yakho yomazisi enezinamba eziyi-13 (noma inombolo yephasi) nemininingwane yakho yomuntu ngokufana ncamashi nokumazisi wakho.

steps.title: Qinisekisa umakhalekhukhwini wakho ne-OTP
steps.description: Qinisekisa inombolo osukuhlezi kuyo. I-SASSA ithumela i-OTP; faka uma ucelwa.

steps.title: Khetha indlela yokukhokha bese uthumela
steps.description: Khetha i-EFT yasebhange noma I-Cash Send, yamukela izimemezelo, bese uthumela. Uthola i-SMS yokuqinisekiswa nenombolo yakho yokubheka.

contentBlocks.title: Isibonelelo esifanayo, imithetho efanayo
contentBlocks.text: Ukufaka isicelo ku-WhatsApp kusebenzisa ukuhlolwa kwezimali nezidingo zokufaneleka ezifanayo ncamashi naloluwezu lwewebhusayithi. Kushintsha kuphela endleleni ofaka ngayo — hhayi umphumela noma inani.
Amadokhumenti Nemininingwane Okudingeka Uyinayo Ngaphambi Kokufaka Isicelo

documents.label: Inombolo yomazisi waseNingizimu Afrika (iziphathimandla eziyi-13) NOMA iphasi elisemthenthefu lokufuna ukukhosela/elikhethekile
documents.notes: Isetshenziselwa ukuqinisekisa umazisi wakho ngokuqhathanisa ne-Home Affairs.

documents.label: Inombolo yomakhalekhukhwini ebhaliswe ngegama lakho
documents.notes: Uthola i-OTP nayo yonke i-SRD status kule nombolo.

documents.label: I-akhawunti yasebhange ngegama lakho (uma ukhetha i-EFT)
documents.notes: Umnikazi wekhawunti kumele afane nomazisi wakho. Ungakhetha i-Cash Send uma ungenayo i-akhawunti yasebhange.

documents.label: Ubufakazi bokungabi namunye umholo (kuphela uma ucelwa ngesikhathi sokufaka isikhalazo)
documents.notes: Isifungo esibhaliwe noma isitatimende sasebhange singadingeka uma inyanga yenqatshiwe.

documents.label: Inombolo yakho yokubheka isicelo (ngemva kokufaka isicelo)
documents.notes: Gcina i-SMS ukuze ukwazi ukubheka isimo nokufaka isikhalazo kamuva.

contentBlocks.text: Akudingeki ukuthi ulayishe amadokhumenti askeniwe ukuze ufake isicelo. I-SASSA iqinisekisa iningi lolwazi nge-elekthronikhi ngokuqhathanisa nezizindalwazi zikahulumeni. Izinto eziyinhloko okudingeka uzinikeze ngokunembile umazisi/nombolo yephasi lakho, inombolo yakho yocingo, nemininingwane yakho yokukhokha. Uma ngezinye izikhathi ushade futhi isibongo sakho sihlukile emarekhodini ase-Home Affairs, qiniseka ukuthi ufaka isicelo usebenzisa igama eliqondile kumazisi wakho ukuze ugweme umphumela 'Ukuqinisekiswa Komazisi Kwehlulekile'. Uma ungenayo i-akhawunti yasebhange, khetha i-Cash Send ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo bese uthatha ezitolo — akukho dokumenti edingekayo ngalokho ngaphandle komazisi wakho.
Ngemva Kokufaka Isicelo: Okwenzekayo Ngesikhathi Sokuqinisekiswa

Ukuthumela isicelo sakho kuyisinyathelo sokuqala kuphela. I-SASSA bese iqhuba inqubo yokuqinisekisa ezenzakalelayo ehlola imininingwane yakho ngokuqhathanisa nezinhlelo eziningi zikahulumeni. Ukuqonda lokhu kukusiza ukubone ukuthi kungani umphumela ungathatha isikhathi — nesizathu sokuthi isimo singashintsha kusukela kwelinye inyanga kuye kwelinye ngisho nangemva kokuba usuphinde wakhokhelwa ngaphambili. Izinhlolo ezifanayo zisebenza njalo ngenyanga, yingakho umtholi wesibonelelo oveye wagunyazwa engase enqatshwe kamuva uma izimo zakhe sishintshana.

steps.label: Ukuhlolwa komazisi (Home Affairs)
steps.description: Umazisi wakho noma iphasi lakho liqhathaniswa neregista yabantu yoMnyango Wezindaba Zangaphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukhona futhi uyisakhamuzi esamukelwayo.

steps.label: Ukuhlolwa kwemali engenayo (SARS / amabhange)
steps.description: I-SASSA ihlola ukuthi ubhalisile ku-PAYE noma ukuthi i-akhawunti yakho yasebhange ibonisa amadiphozithi ngenhla komkhawulo ka-R624.

steps.label: Ukuhlolwa kwe-UIF
steps.description: Umazisi wakho uhlolwa ngokuqhathanisa nohlelo lwe-UIF ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi awutholi izinkokhelo zomshwalense wokungasebenzi.

steps.label: Ukuhlolwa kwe-NSFAS
steps.description: Umazisi wakho uhlolwa ngokuqhathanisa namarekhodi e-NSFAS ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi awuxhaswa njengomfundi njengamanje.

steps.label: Ukuhlolwa kwesinye isibonelelo
steps.description: I-SASSA iqinisekisa ukuthi awusatholi esinye isibonelelo se-SASSA (ngaphandle kweChild Support Grant yengane yakho).

steps.label: Ukuhlolwa kwesikhungo sikahulumeni
steps.description: Kubheka ukuthi awuhlali ejele noma esikhungweni sokunakekelwa esixhaswa nguhulumeni.

contentBlocks.title: Isikhathi Sokwenza Isinqumo Sokuqala
contentBlocks.text: Ukuqinisekiswa kokuqala ngokuvamile kuthatha izinsuku ezimbalwa kuya emasontweni ambalwa. Ngemva kwalokho, inyanga ngayinye ibuyekezwa ngokuzenzakalelayo kusetshenziswa izinhlolo ezifanayo, ngakho awufaki isicelo kabusha — kodwa kumele uqhubeke ubheka isimo sakho, ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini eziseduze nezokukhokha.
Isizathu Sokwaliwa Kwezicelo Ze-SRD — Nokuthi Ngasinye Singalungiswa Kanjani

items: Umholo ongenhla komkhawulo: ibhange lakho labonisa amadiphozithi angaphezu kuka-R624 enyangeni ehlolwayo. Isixazululo: uma imali ibingeyona imali engenayo (isipho, ukubuyiselwa kwemali mboleko, noma iphutha), faka isikhalazo ngesifungo esibhaliwe esichaza idiphozithi ngayinye.

Umazisi awufani ne-Home Affairs: igama lakho noma usuku lokuzalwa alufani namarekhodi. Isixazululo: qedela isicelomsebenzi sokuqinisekiswa kobuso kuphaneli le-SRD, noma buyekeza imininingwane yakho e-Ezindabeni Zangaphakathi (Home Affairs), bese uhlola kabusha.

Usunesinye isibonelelo: isimiso sibona ukuthi uthola esinye isibonelelo se-SASSA. Isixazululo: kumele ukhethe isibonelelo esisodwa; uma esinye sesiphela, buyekeza amarekhodi akho bese ufaka isikhalazo ngenyanga enqatshiwe.
Kutholwe i-NSFAS: umakwe njengomfundi oxhasiwe. Isixazululo: uma uxhaso lwakho lwe-NSFAS seluphelile, layisha incwadi yokukhanselwa noma yokuqedela bese ufaka isikhalazo.
Kutholwe i-UIF: uthola i-UIF. Isixazululo: uma i-UIF isiyekile, faka isikhalazo ngenyanga nencwadi yakho yokuyekiswa kwe-UIF.

Ulwazi lokukhwabanisa noma olungalungile: kunikelwe imininingwane engamanga. Isixazululo: lungisa isicelo sakho ngephaneli noma ehhovisi le-SASSA; ungaze wathumela imininingwane engamanga, engaholela ekudluliselweni kwenkohliso.

contentBlocks.title: Faka isikhalazo, ungazambe nje ukufaka isicelo kabusha
contentBlocks.text: Ukufaka isicelo kabusha ngemininingwane efanayo ngeke kulungise ukwaliwa futhi kungadala izinto eziphindwe kabili. Indlela elungile ukufaka isikhalazo ngenyanga ethile enqatshiwe nge-Tribunal Ezimele (ITSAA) phakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-30 (noma kuze kube izinsuku ezingama-90 ngephaneli ye-ITSAA).
Indlela Yokufaka Isikhalazo Ngenyanga Ye-SRD Enqatshiwe

Uma inyanga ethile inqatshiwe futhi ukholelwa ukuthi isinqumo asilungile, ungafaka isikhalazo. Izikhalazo ziphethwa ngokuzimela yi-Independent Tribunal for Social Assistance Appeals (ITSAA), hhayi i-SASSA. Imithetho emibili ibalulekile: kumele ufake isikhalazo phakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-30 (noma kuze kube ezingama-90 ngephaneli ye-ITSAA) kusukela kwenyanga enqatshiwe, futhi kumele ufake isikhalazo ngenyanga ngayinye enqatshiwe ngokwehlukana, ngoba inyanga ngayinye ihlolwa ngokwayo. Ukuze uthole ukuhamba okuphelele, bheka ikhasi lomhlahlandlela wokufaka isikhalazo elixhunyaniswe ngezansi.

steps.title: Iya kuphaneli lokufaka izikhalazo
steps.description: Vakashela i-srd.sassa.gov.za/appeal noma i-itsaa.gov.za. Lezi izishaneli ezisemthenthefu zokufaka izikhalazo ze-ITSAA.

steps.title: Faka umazisi wakho nocingo
steps.description: Nikeza inombolo yakho yomazisi kanye nenombolo yocingo esetshenziswe esicelweni sakho, bese uqinisekisa nge-OTP ethunyelwe.

steps.title: Khetha inyanga enqatshiwe
steps.description: Khetha inyanga ethile eboniswa 'Sinqatshiwe'. Phinda lokhu ngenyanga ngayinye ofuna ukuyiphikisa — azihlanganiswa zibe isikhalazo esisodwa.

steps.title: Yisho isizathu sakho
steps.description: Khetha isizathu esifanele (isib., awusebenzi, awunamali engenayo, noma i-UIF/NSFAS seyaphela).

steps.title: Layisha ubufakazi
steps.description: Faka amadokhumenti asekelayo: isifungo esibhaliwe, izitatimende zasebhange, incwadi yokuyekiswa ye-UIF, noma incwadi yokukhanselwa ye-NSFAS, ngokufanele.

steps.title: Thumela bese ugcina inkomba yakho
steps.description: Thumela bese ulondoloza inombolo yakho Yokubheka Isikhalazo. I-ITSAA izokwazisa umphumela, ongathatha amasonto amaningi.

contentBlocks.title: Iwindi Lezinsuku Ezingama-30 Liqukile
contentBlocks.text: Umkhawulo wezinsuku ezingama-30 ubalwa kusukela ngosuku lwenyanga enqatshiwe. Uma uwudlulile, leyo nyanga ngokuvamile ayikwazi ukuphinde icatshangelwe, ngakho bheka isimo sakho njalo bese ufaka isikhalazo ngokushesha.
Ukukhokha: Ummunye Nendlela Okukhokhwa Ngayo

Lapho inyanga igunyazwa, i-SASSA ikhokha phakathi kokusondele komhla wama-25 nosuku lokugcina lwaleyo nyanga. Asikho usuku olulodwa oluhleliwe lokukhokha lwawo wonke umuntu; izinkokhelo zikhishwa ngokuqhubekayo, futhi usuku lwakho olunembile luncike ebankini lakho noma endleleni yakho yokuthatha. Ukuze uthole uhlelo oluphelele nezinyathelo zokushintsha indlela, bheka umhlahlandlela wezindlela zokukhokha ze-SRD nencazelo yokubuyekezwa kwanyanga zonke ezixhunyaniswe ngezansi. Isifingqo ngezansi siqukethe izinketho eziyinhloko.

rows: Ngokuvamile ishesha kakhulu; i-akhawunti kumele ibe ngeyakho.
Thatha e-Pick n Pay, e-Boxer, e-Shoprite, e-Checkers, noma e-USave usebenzisa i-voucher ye-SMS
Akukho akhawunti yasebhange edingekayo; letha umazisi wakho ne-voucher.
Iye liqukwa ngokuqhubekayo — shintshela ebhange noma ezitolo.
contentBlocks.caption: Izinyanga ezigunyaziwe zikhokhelwa ngaphakathi kwewindi lokukhokha lanyanga zonke; ukukhetha kwendlela kwenziwa kuphaneli le-SRD.

contentBlocks.title: I-Black card / ukudluliselwa ku-Postbank
contentBlocks.text: I-SASSA ithatha indawo yekhadi elidala eliqgolide le-SASSA ngelisha elinsundu le-Postbank. I-SASSA ishilve umhlahlandlela wokudlulisela osuku olungu-31 August 2026 lokuba abatholi besibonelelo bashintshe amakhadi abo e-Postbank noma e-SASSA ukuze baqhubeke nokuthola izinkokhelo. Izinsuku zingashintsha, ngakho qinisekisa usuku lwanje ezishaneleni ezisemthenthefu ze-SASSA neze-Postbank ngaphambi kokuhamba.
Ukugcina Isibonelelo Sakho: Ukuqinisekisa Kabusha Nokuphelelwa

Isibonelelo se-SRD asikona amandla okugunyazwa unomphela. I-SASSA idinga ukuba abatholi besibonelelo baqinisekise kabusha imininingwane yabo cishe njalo ngezinyanga ezintathu, futhi ibuyekeza ukufaneleka njalo ngenyanga kusetshenziswa ukuhlolwa kwezimali. Uma inyanga yehluleka ukuhlolwa, leyo nyanga ayikhokhwa — isibonelelo 'siyelile' kuleyo nyanga kunokuba sikhanselwe ngokuphelele. Ukuqhubeka nokukhokhelwa kuncike ekugcineni imininingwane yakho isesikhathini nokuhlangabezana nokuhlolwa ngempela njalo ngenyanga. Abatholi abaningi bathuka lapho inkokhelo eboye ithembekile ima; kulandza zonke izimo, kuba kakhulu ngoba ukuhlolwa kwanyanga zonke kuthole umholo noma uphawu lwedatha.

items: Umholo ongenhla kuka-R624 otholwe ngenyanga — imbangela evame kakhulu yokungakhokhi.
Inombolo yakho yocingo noma imininingwane yasebhange iyeshintsha futhi ayibuyekezwa kuphaneli, ngakho i-SASSA ayikwazi ukuqinisekisa noma ukukhokha kuwe.
Uqala ukuthola i-UIF, i-NSFAS, noma esinye isibonelelo se-SASSA.
Umakwe njengohlala esikhungweni sikahulumeni.
Uyayiphutha iwindi lokuziqinisekisa kabusha futhi irekhodi lakho likhohlakale.

contentBlocks.title: Buyekeza, ungabamisi
contentBlocks.text: Gcina inombolo yakho yocingo, imininingwane yakho yasebhange, nemininingwane yakho yomuntu isesikhathini kuphaneli le-SRD. Uma izimo zakho zishintsha, ukubuyekeza ngokushesha kusiza ukugwema inkokhelo ephuthele. Ziqinisekise kabusha lapho ucelwa, cishe njalo ngezinyanga ezintathu.
I-SRD Iqhathaniswa Nezinye Izibonelelo Ze-SASSA

Isibonelelo se-SRD R370 singesinye sezibonelelo zokuxhumana komphakathi eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa siyehluka: siyisikhashana, sinokuhlolwa kwezimali okuqinile kwanyanga zonke, futhi siqondiswe kubantu abadala abasezingeni lokusebenza abangenalunye usizo. Ithebula ngezansi liqhathanisa nezibonelelo eziyinhloko ezingapheli. Izimali zezibonelelo ezingezona ze-SRD zishintsha unyaka nonyaka futhi kufanele ziqinisekiswe kuwebhusayithi esemthenthefu ye-SASSA; izinombolo lapha zigxila kumehluko wobunjiniyela obalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukufaneleka.

contentBlocks.caption: Ukuqhathaniswa kokwakheka kuphela. Qinisekisa izimali zamanje kuwebhusayithi esemthenthefu ye-SASSA.

contentBlocks.title: Okukhethekile Ngesibonelelo Sengane
contentBlocks.text: Ngokuvamile awukwazi ukuthola i-SRD ngenkathi uthola esinye isibonelelo se-SASSA. Okukhethekile Isibonelelo Sengane esikhokhelwa ingane yakho — ungathola leso KANYE nesibonelelo se-SRD, ngoba isibonelelo sengane ngesengane leyo, hhayi esakho.
Zivikele Emikhubeni Ye-SRD

contentBlocks.title: I-SASSA ngeke icela lezi zinto
contentBlocks.text: I-SASSA nohlelo lwe-SRD ngeke LUZE icela i-PIN yakho, iphasiwedi, noma i-OTP. Ngeke LUZE ibiza imali ukufaka isicelo, ukubheka isimo sakho, noma 'ukusheshisa' inkokhelo. Noma ngubani owenza lokho ungumkhohlisi.

items: Iwebhusayithi ezingamanga zokubheka 'isimo' ezilinganisa i-srd.sassa.gov.za futhi zintshontsha umazisi wakho ne-OTP.
Imilayezo ifuna i-airtime noma 'imali yokuvula' ngaphambi kokuba ukhokhelwe.
Abantu abanikela ukuthi 'bayakhuphula' noma 'basheshise' isibonelelo sakho ngekhomishini.
Izingcingo noma i-WhatsApp ezicela i-PIN yasebhange yakho noma 'zokuthi ukuqinisekise' iphasiwedi yakho.
Izixhumanisi zobugebengu (phishing) ezithunyelwa nge-SMS noma nge-imeyili ezisho ukuthi zivela ku-SASSA.

contentBlocks.text: Hlala usebenzisa iphaneli elisemthenthefu srd.sassa.gov.za, umugqa osemthenthefu we-WhatsApp 082 046 8553, noma ihhovisi eliphathekayo le-SASSA. Uma ungaqiniseki ukuthi umlayezo ungokoqobo, ungaqhafi izixhumanisi noma ubelane ngamakhodi — vula isayithi elisemthenthefu ngqo kubrowser wakho. Bika imikhuba ku-SASSA Fraud Hotline ku-0800 60 10 11. Khumbula: ukufaka isicelo, ukubheka isimo, nokufaka isikhalazo konke kuyimahhala, futhi akukho nqubo esebenza ngokuthi uthenge i-airtime noma ukhokhe 'i-agent'.
Umjikelezo We-SRD: Ukuhamba Ngenyanga Ngenyanga

Isibonelelo se-SRD siqondwa kangcono njengomjikelezo wanyanga zonke ophindaphindwayo kunokuthi kugunyazwa kanye kuphela. Ngenyanga yokuqala ufaka isicelo bese i-SASSA isebenzisa izinhlolo zayo; uma udlula, ukhokhelwa kuleyo nyanga. Ngenyanga yesibili izinhlolo ezifanayo zisebenza kabusha ngokuzenzakalelayo — awufaki isicelo kabusha, kodwa usangafika umphakathi ukwenqatshwa uma, isib., idiphozithi ikukhuphulela ngaphezu kuka-R624. Lokhu kuyaqhubeka inqobo nje uma uhlelo luxhaswe imali futhi uhlangabezana nokuhlolwa. Cishe njalo ngezinyanga ezintathu, i-SASSA ikucela ukuba uziqinisekise kabusha, okuwukuthi nje ukuqinisekisa futhi ukuthi isimo sakho asishintshile ngokuyisisekelo. Ukucabanga ngesibonelelo njengokuhlolwa kwanyanga zonke, hhayi njengelungelo elingapheli, kukusiza ugweme izinto ezimangalisayo.

Emjikelezweni ngamunye, izinsuku ezibalulekile yilezi zokuthatha isicelo (ongasithumela nganoma yisiphi isikhathi), ukuhlolwa (okuqhubekayo), newindi lokukhokha (cishe kusukela ngomhla wama-25 kuya osukwini lokugcina lwenyanga lezinyanga ezigunyaziwe). Akukho nzuzo yokufaka isicelo 'ngasekuqaleni kwenyanga' ngezinjongo zokukhokha, ngoba inkokhelo ilandela ukugunyazwa newindi lokukhokha elinqunyiwe, hhayi usuku lokuthumela isicelo. Okubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi imininingwane yakho ilungile ukuze izinhlolo ezenzakalelayo zidlule futhi inkokhelo ifike kuwe. Uma ukuhlolwa kwehluleka, inyanga ayikhokhwa, futhi ngokuvamile ukubona kuphela lapho ubheka isimo sakho noma ungaboni imali ifika.

Abatholi besibonelelo abacabanga ukuthi lesi sibonelelo 'sisethiwe bese usikhohlwa' yibo ababanjwa. Indaba evame kakhulu umuntu obekhokhelwa izinyanga ezintathu, bese umzalwane edephozitha imali yomcimbi womkhaya, isimiso siphawula 'umthombo wemali ongomunye', bese inyanga elandelayo isebenze. Ngenxa yokuthi umuntu ubengabheki isimo, ubona kuphela emasontweni kamuva. Ukwenza umkhuba wokubheka isimo cishe ngomhla wama-20 unyaka ngalunye, ngaphambi kwewindi lokukhokha, kukuvumela ubone futhi ufake izikhalazo ngamasuthu agoqo — ngaphakathi kwewindi lezinsuku ezingama-30 lokufaka izikhalazo.
Okushiwo Ngempela 'Kusacutshungulwa', 'Isemukelwe', Nokuthi 'Sinqatshiwe'

Kusacutshungulwa yisimo sokuqala esingathathi uhlangothi. Kusho ukuthi i-SASSA inesicelo sakho kodwa ayikaqedi ukuhlola okufanayo ngokuqhathanisa ne-Home Affairs, i-SARS, i-UIF, ne-NSFAS. Akusikho ukwenqaba. Izicelo eziningi zokuthola okokuqala zihlala 'Kusacutshungulwa' izinsuku ezimbalwa kuya emasontweni ambalwa. Uma uhlala 'Kusacutshungulwa' isikhathi esingavamile ukuthi sibe side, kungabonisa ukungafani — isib., isibongo sakho esicelweni asifani ne-Home Affairs — esiyimisa ukuqinisekiswa ngokuthula. Kuleso simo, ukuqedela isicelomsebenzi sokuqinisekiswa kobuso noma ukuvakashela i-Home Affairs ukuze uqondanise amarekhodi akho ngokuvamile kuyakuvula.

Isemukelwe kusho ukuthi udlule izinhlolo zaleyo nyanga ethile futhi inkokhelo kufanele yonikezele ewindini lenyanga. Akuqinisekisi ukuthi imali ifikile — kuphela ukuthi yagunyazwa. Izinyanga ezigunyaziwe zingabonisa 'Kwenziwa Inkokhelo' kamuva bese zivela ekhawuntini yakho noma njengevoucher ethathekayo. Uma ukhonjiswa 'Isemukelwe' kodwa ungaboni inkokhelo ngemva kokuvalwa kwewindi, hlola imininingwane yakho yasebhange, futhi uma ilungile, xhumana ne-SASSA unenombolo yakho yokubheka. Ukugunyazwa kuhlala kugxile enyangeni ethile futhi kumele kuphinde kutholakale ngenyanga elandelayo.

Sinqatshiwe kusho ukuthi izinhlolo zehlulekile kuleyo nyanga. Isizathu ngokuvamile siyaboniswa: 'Umthombo Wemali Ongomunye' (amadiphozithi angaphezu kuka-R624), 'Usunesinye isibonelelo', 'Kutholwe i-UIF', 'Kutholwe i-NSFAS', noma ukungafani komazisi. Sinqatshiwe sigxile enyangeni ethile — akukuthi kukhanselwe isibonelelo sakho sonke, futhi ungakhonjiswa 'Isemukelwe' futhi ngenyanga elandelayo uma isimo sakho sishintsha. Isenzo esibalulekile ukufaka isikhalazo ngenyanga enqatshiwe phakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-30 (noma kuze kube izinsuku ezingama-90 ngephaneli ye-ITSAA) uma ukholelwa ukuthi akulungile. Ukunganaki ukwaliwa kuthi leyo nyanga ilahleke unomphela lapho iwindi liphela.
Ukubambezeleka Kwenkokhelo Nokuthi Ungenzeni

Nangemva kokugunyazwa, inkokhelo ingase ibambezeleke. Imbangela evame kakhulu imininingwane yasebhange engalungile noma ekuphinyeni — i-EFT iyathunyelwa kodwa ibuye emuva, futhi imali ibuyiselwa ku-SASSA. Eyesibili ukukhetha i-Cash Send kodwa ungayithathi i-voucher, noma uwulokhu ulahlekelwa i-SMS. Eyesithathu imane nje ukuba semuva ekukhishweni okuqhubekayo; i-SASSA ayikhokhi wonke umuntu ngolusuku olulodwa, ngakho umngane othola inkokhelo ngomhla wama-25 kanti wena uthole ngomhla wama-29 kujwayelekile, akusilo iphutha. Ukubekezela ngaphakathi kwewindi ngokuvamile kufanelekile.

Uma isimo sakho singu-'Kwenziwa Inkokhelo' noma 'Isemukelwe' futhi iwindi lingakavalwa, linda — ukudluliselwa kungathatha usuku olulodwa kuya kwezintathu zokusebenza ukuba kubonakale. Uma iwindi selivaliwe futhi akukho ofikile, qala ngokuvula kabusha iphaneli le-SRD bese uqinisekisa ukuthi i-akhawunti yasebhange noma inombolo yocingo kurekodini ilungile futhi ingeyakho. Lungisa uma kudingeka (ushintsho lusebenza kusukela ngenyanga elandelayo) bese uhlola kabusha. Uma imininingwane ilungile futhi inkokhelo ithelwe ngempela, xhumana neziko lezingcingo le-SASSA noma uvakashele ihhovisi unomazisi nenombolo yakho yokubheka; gebe izithombe zesimo sakho.

Qaphela imikhuba 'yokuvula inkokhelo' ngesikhathi sokubambezeleka. Abakhohlisi bathumela imilayezo abathi esikhundleni sabatholi besibonelelo bathi inkokhelo yabo 'mayisulwe' futhi 'iyikhishwe' ngenkokhelo noma ngokwabelana nge-OTP. I-SASSA ayikaze imise izinkokhelo ngenkokhelo, futhi ukwabelana nge-OTP yakho kuwumvumela umkhohlisi ukuba aqondise kabusha imali. Uma umlayezo ukukhupha inkani ukuze ukhokhe noma ubelane ngamakhodi ukuze 'ukhishwe' isibonelelo, kungukukhwabanisa — bika ku-SASSA Fraud Hotline ku-0800 60 10 11. Hlala uqinisekisa isimo senkokhelo kuphela kuphaneli elisemthenthefu.
Izimo Ezikhethekile Zempilo

Ukugcwalisa iminyaka engu-60: Isibonelelo se-SRD senzelwe iminyaka ephakathi kuka-18 no-59. Inyanga othola ngayo uminyaka ongu-60, awusafaneleki ukuthola i-SRD futhi kumele udlulele kwi-Older Person's Grant, elingapheli futhi elikhokha inani eliphakeme. Vakashela ihhovisi le-SASSA ukuze ufake isicelo; ungavumeli nje ukuba uqhubeke ulindele i-SRD, ngoba isimiso sizoyimisa 60 ngempela. Ukuhlela lokhu kudluliswa ngasekupheleni konyaka wakho kugwema igebe lemali, futhi noma yisiphi isikhalazo se-SRD ngqa ezingeni leminyaka ngokuvamile asibe nasisekelo uma isidingo seminyaka sehluleka.

Ukuqala umsebenzi: Uma uqala umsebenzi osemthenthefu (PAYE) noma uqala ukuthola okungaphezu kuka-R624 ngenyanga, izinyanga zakho ze-SRD zizonqatshwa. Lokhu kuziphatha okufanele, akusilo iphutha — isibonelelo senzelwe abangenamali engenayo noma bancane. Uma umsebenzi uphela futhi usubuye waba ngaphansi komkhawulo, izinyanga zakamuva zingagunyazwa; faka isikhalazo nganoma iyiphi inyanga enqatshiwe ngokungalungile ngemva kokuyeka komsebenzi ngokunikezela nencwadi yokuyekiswa. Imali engenayo engakahlelekile, ephansi kakhulu engaphansi komkhawulo ayikwenzi ungafaneleki, kodwa ihlolwa ngokwalokho okufika ebhange lakho.

Ukuba nengane: Ukuzalwa kwengane akushintshi ukufaneleka kwakho kwe-SRD, futhi kungase futhi kukuvumele ufake isicelo seChild Support Grant yalowo ngane. Khumbula okubalulekile: ukuthola isibonelelo seChild Support Grant yingane yakho AKUKUENZI ungafaneleki ukuthola i-SRD. Ngakho umzali angathola kokubili — isibonelelo sengane ngenzani ne-SRD mayelana naye — inqobo nje uma umzali ehlangabezana nazo zonke izidingo ze-SRD (iminyaka ephakathi kuka-18 no-59, umholo waka-R624 noma ngaphansi, akukho i-UIF/NSFAS, futhi engasemkhungweni sikahulumeni).
Indlela I-SASSA Exhumana Ngayo Nawe

I-SASSA ixhumana nabatholi besibonelelo ikakhulukazi nge-SMS kwinombolo yocingo erekhodini. Lezi zithumela SMS ziphotoshe i-OTP yakho ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo nokubheka isimo, inkomba yakho yokubheka isicelo, kanye ne-voucher yakho ye-Cash Send uma uthatha ezitolo. Phatha noma yimuphi umlayezo ocela i-PIN yakho, iphasiwedi, noma i-OTP njengosuspekayo — i-SASSA ithumela amakhodi kodwa ayikaze ikucele ukuthi uwafunde futhi noma ukhokhe ukuze uwasebenzise. Imilayezo yangempela ye-SASSA ngeke ibe nezixhumanisi ezifuna inkokhelo esheshayo.

Ngenxa yokuthi ukuxhumana kusekelwe ku-SMS, ukugcina inombolo yakho isebenza futhi ingeyakho kubalulekile. Uma ushintsha izinombolo, buyekeza iphaneli ngokushesha. Uma umakhalekhukhwini wakho ulahlekile, i-OTP ayikwazi ukufika kuwe futhi ungase uvalelwe ngaphandle kokubheka isimo nokufaka izikhalazo kuze kube yilapho uvakashela ihhovisi ukuze uqinisekise umazisi wakho. Ukusetha isikhumbuzo esilula sokubheka isimo ngenyanga nakho kuyasiza, ngoba i-SASSA ngeke ijaye ibhekane nombutho wesibonelo ngamunye omuthi inkokhelo yakhe ilahlekile. Ukugcina imininingwane yakho yokuxhumana isesimweni esihle kuvimbela izinkinga eziningi ezingagwemekile.
Ubufakazi Obuqinisa Isikhalazo

items: Isifungo esibhaliwe esichaza noma iyiphi idiphozithi ebingeyona imali engenayo (isipho, ukubuyiselwa kwemail mboleko, noma iphutha).
Izitatimende zasebhange ezibonisa imali engenayo yangempela yanyanga zonke esikhathini sokwaliwa.
Incwadi yokuyekiswa ye-UIF, uma i-UIF iyona isizathu futhi seluphelile.
Incwadi yokukhanselwa noma yokuqedelelwa ye-NSFAS, uma i-NSFAS iyona isizathu.
Ubufakazi bokuthi esinye isibonelelo seluphelile, uma 'usunesinye isibonelelo' siyona isizathu.
Umazisi wakho kanye nenombolo yokubheka isicelo nokubheka isikhalazo.

contentBlocks.text: Lapho ufaka isikhalazo, layisha amadokhumenti aphendula ngqo isizathu sokwaliwa. Isikhalazo esinge abufakazi maningi mathuba okuba siphumelele, ngoba i-ITSAA icubungula ukuthi isinqumo se-SASSA sibe silungile yini ngasedatha etholakalayo. Ubufakazi obucacile nobuthile — ikakhulukazi isifungo esibhaliwe esichaza idiphozithi ngayinye engingacaci — iyona ndlela ephumelela kakhulu yokubuyisela ukwaliwa kwe-'Umthombo Wemali Ongomunye'. Gcina amakhophi akho konke okuthumelayo bese uyabhala noma qaphela inombolo yakho Yokubheka Isikhalazo ukuze ukwazi ukulandela.
Izizindalwazi Zikahulumeni Ezisebenzela Isicelo Sakho

UMnyango Wezindaba Zangaphakathi (Home Affairs): Lona ngumthombo weqiniso womazisi wakho. I-SASSA ihlola ukuthi umazisi wakho noma iphasi lakho likhona futhi lifana negama nosuku lokuzalwa owakuthumelile. Ukungafani yimbangela ejwayelekile 'Ukuqinisekiswa Komazisi Kwehlulekile'. Ukuqondanisa imininingwane yakho e-Home Affairs, noma ukuqedela isinyathelo sokuqinisekiswa kobuso kuphaneli, kuxazulula iningi lalokhu. Hlala ufaka isicelo usebenzisa igama eliqondile eliku-mazisi wakho ukuze ugweme lokhu ngokuphelele.

I-South African Revenue Service (SARS): Idatha ye-SARS itshela i-SASSA ukuthi ubhalisile ku-PAYE noma wamemezela umholo womsebenzi. Uma ubhalwe njengosebenza onomholo ongenhla komkhawulo, uzonqatshwa. Abasebenzi bangaphambili kwesinye isikhathi bahlala ohlweni lwe-PAYE lomqashi wangaphambili ngemva kokushiya; ukulungisa lokho ne-SARS bese ufaka isikhalazo yindlela yokulungisa. Yikho lokhu kungenza umsebenzi omudala uvimbe isibonelelo ngokungalungile kuze kube yilapho amarekhodi ebuyekeziwe.

I-UIF (Umkhakha Womshwalense Wokungasebenzi): Uma uthola i-UIF, isimiso siyabona bese yenqaba i-SRD, ngoba i-UIF iyimali engenayo enqikaza ukufaneleka. Uma i-UIF iyepa, nikeza incwadi yokuyekiswa bese ufaka isikhalazo ngezinyanga ezithintekile. Qaphela ukuthi ukufaka isandla ku-UIF ngezinsuku zakudala akukwenzi ubesulwe — kuphela izinkokhelo ze-UIF ezisebenzayo eziyimfihlo. Ukuhlolwa kusekelwe kurejista ye-UIF ebukayo ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa.

I-NSFAS: Ngenkathi usengumfundi we-NSFAS oxhasiwe osebenzayo, awufaneleki. Ngemva kokuphela kwezifundo zakho noma kokuphela kokuxhaswa, layisha incwadi efanele bese ufaka isikhalazo. Qaphela ukuthi ukuba umfundi kuphela akunqikazi — kuphela uxhaso lwe-NSFAS olusebenzayo olunqikazayo. Ama-bursary azimele nokusekwa komndeni akuzona i-NSFAS, kodwa noma iyiphi idiphozithi evamile evela kukho ibalwa enanini lakho lomholo ka-R624, ngakho zisengathinta ukuhlolwa kwezimali.
Umehluko Wezifunda Nokuthathwa Kwezimali

Isibonelelo se-SRD sesifundazweni sonke, kodwa indlela osithola ngayo ingahluka ngendawo. Emadolobheni amakhulu nasezithembini, ukuthatha ezitolo e-Pick n Pay, e-Boxer, e-Shoprite, e-Checkers, nase-USave kuyatholakala kabanzi, futhi i-EFT yasebhange iyona ekhokhwayo ngokuvamile kwabanama-akhawunti. Ezindaweni ezikude kakhulu, amaphoyinti ezitolo angase abe ambalwa, okwenza i-akhawunti yasebhange noma izinketho ezisele ze-Post Office zibaluleke — nakuba ukuthatha ukheshe kwe-SAPO kuyaqhubeka ukushuthwa, ngakho abatholi besibonelelo kulezo zindawo kufanele babeke phambili ekuvuleni i-akhawunti yasebhange elula noma baqinisekise umhlanganyeli oseduze wokuthatha. I-SASSA imemezela amalungiselelo okuthatha ezishaneleni zayo ezisemthenthefu, futhi amahhovisi e-SASSA endawo angakucebisa ngendawo eseduze kakhulu yokukhokha.
Uma I-SRD Yakho Ima: I-Plan B Esetshenziswayo

Isibonelelo se-SRD siyisikhashana ngokwakheka futhi singama ngezizathu eziningi ezisemthenthefu — uthola umsebenzi, ugcwalisa iminyaka engu-60, noma uhlelo luyaphela. Ngenxa yokuthi akusiyo imali engenayo eqinisekisiwe, kuhle ukungayakhi izibopho ezisema-nifesto zigxile kuso. Uma i-SRD yakho iyeka, qala ubheke ukuthi kungani: funda isizathu sesimo, futhi uma singalungile, faka isikhalazo phakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-30 (noma kuze kube izinsuku ezingama-90 ngephaneli ye-ITSAA). Uma silungile (isib., manje ususebenza), guqula ukugxila uye emalini engenayo noma kolunye usizo onalo manje kunokuba uqhubeke ucabanga ukuthi isibonelelo singapheli.

Uma isibonelelo siphela futhi ungenamunye umholo, hlola ezinye izinhlobo zosizo: izibonelelo ezisemthenthefu ze-SASSA uma usufanelekile manje (Isibonelelo Sokucela Uhilulo, Isibonelelo Sokukhubazeka, Isibonelelo Sengane), i-UIF uma usanda kunciphisa umsebenzi, noma izinhlelo zikamasipala zokusiza abampofu nokudla eziqhutshwa umkhandlu wakho wendawo. Akurikho kulokhu okutholakala ngephaneli le-SRD, ngakho xhumana nomnyango noma ihhovisi elifanele. Okubalulekile ukuthi usebenze kusenesikhathi kunokuba ulinde kuze kuphele imali yokonga, ngoba izicelo nokugunyazwa kuthatha isikhathi.
Izimo Ezijwayelekile, Ziphendulwe Kafushane

items: Ngikhokhelwe ngenyanga edlule kodwa hhayi kule: bheka isimo sakho; idiphozithi ingase ikukhuphulele ngaphezu kuka-R624, noma isimiso sikumake. Faka isikhalazo uma kungalungile.
Umzalwane wami uthumela imali kwesinye isikhathi: lawa madiphozithi abalwa esilinganisweni sakho esingu-R624; uwachaze ngesifungo esibhaliwe uma unqatshwa.
Ngifake isicelo ku-WhatsApp nakuwebhusayithi: sebenzisa inkomba yakho yokuqala; izinto eziphindwe kabili zihlanganiswa, aziphindwanga.
Ngithole i-SMS ethi 'qofa lapha ukuze uqinisekise': qinisekisa kuphela ngaphakathi kwesayithi elisemthenthefu srd.sassa.gov.za; ungaqhafi izixhumanisi ezingaziwa.
Isibonelelo sami sibonisa 'Isemukelwe' kodwa inani libukeka lincane: i-SRD iyasingu-R370 ngenyanga egunyaziwa; awukho amanani ayingxenye, ngakho qinisekisa ukuthi ufunda isaziso esilungile.

contentBlocks.text: Ukufaka Isicelo Ubuntu Ehhovisi Le-SASSA

Nakuba isibonelelo saklanywa ukuba sifakwe ku-inthanethi noma nge-WhatsApp, usenokwenza isicelo noma uthole usizo ubuso nobuso ehhovisi le-SASSA noma e-kiosk yosizo. Lokhu kuyasiza uma ungenayo i-smartphone noma ubhekana nobunzima nenqubo yedijithali. Umphumela nezidingo ziyafana; kuphela kushintsha indlela ofaka ngayo. Abasebenzi basinceda ngaphandle kwezindleko, futhi akufanele ukuthi ukhokhe i-'agent' ehhovisi noma eduze kwalo ukuba athumele isicelo egameni lakho.

steps.description: Bheka ihhovisi le-SASSA noma i-kiosk evunyiwe. Fika kusenesikhathi, ngoba imigqa ingaba mide.

steps.title: Letha umazisi wakho nocingo
steps.description: Thatha umazisi wakho noma iphasi lakho kanye nomakhalekhukhwini obhaliswe ngegama lakho ukuze uthole i-OTP.

steps.description: Ilunga labasebenzi noma i-kiosk yokuzisiza ikuholela emigqeni efanayo nemiphenyl yeplaneli.

steps.description: Qinisekisa imininingwane yakho, qedela isinyathelo se-OTP, bese uthola inombolo yakho yokubheka nge-SMS.

contentBlocks.text: Ukusebenzisa Iphaneli Le-SRD Ngemva Kokufaka Isicelo

Uma usufake isicelo, iphaneli i-srd.sassa.gov.za liba yisizinda sakho sokuqondisa. Ngemva kokungena ngomazisi wakho ne-OTP, ungabheka isimo, ubuke umphumela wenyanga ngayinye, ushintshe indlela yakho yokukhokha, ubuyekeze imininingwane yakho yasebhange neyocingo, bese uqala isikhalazo senyanga enqatshiwe. Ukubheka iphaneli ngenyanga iwumkhuba obalulekile wokugwema izinkokhelo eziphuthele, ngoba kukubonisa isizathu esiqondile sokwaliwa kwenyanga — ulwazi oludingayo ukuze ufake isikhalazo ngendlela efanele.

Iphaneli likhipha futhi inkomba yokuziqinisekisa kabusha cishe njalo ngezinyanga ezintathu. Lapho ivela, yiqedele ngokushesha; ukuyayinaki kungashiya irekhodi lakho lidala futhi kungathinta izinkokhelo. Inkomba akuwona umphumela wokufaka isicelo esisha futhi ayibuyiseli isibonelelo sakho emuva — iwukuqinisekisa kabusha nje. Yiphatha njengomqondisi ojwayelekile, futhi uyihlanganise nokubuyekeza okusheshayo kweminingwane yakho yasebhange neyocingo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi konke okukwi-fayela kusalungile.
Ukuqonda Inkomba Yokuziqinisekisa Kabusha

Ukuziqinisekisa kabusha (kwesinye isikhathi kubizwa ngokuthi ukubuyekeza ukuqinisekisa) yindlela ye-SASSA yokuqinisekisa ukuthi abatholi besibonelelo basahlangabezana nezidingo ngaphandle kokucindezela isicelo esisha esigcwele njalo ngezinyanga ezimbalwa. Lapho ucelwa, uqinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane yakho yomuntu ilungile nokuthi akukho okuguqukile ngokuyisisekelo kumholo wakho noma ezimeni zakho. Izinhlolo ezizenzekelayo zanyanga zonke zisaqhubeka noma kanjani; ukuqinisekisa kabusha wukuqinisekiswa okwengeziwe okwenziwa ngezikhathi ezithile okubekwe ngaphezu kwezozinhlolo.

Ukuyiphutha inkomba yokuziqinisekisa kabusha akukhanseli isibonelelo sakho ngokushesha, kodwa kungashiya ifayela lakho 'lidala' okuphazamisa izinkokhelo nokuqinisekiswa. Uma ubona ukuthi uyiphuthile, ngema bese uyiqedela ngokushesha nangokunokwenzeka, bese ubheka isimo sezinyanga zakamuva ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izinkokhelo azithintekanga. Inkomba ivame ukuphinda cishe ngemjikelezo wezinyanga ezintathu, ngakho ukusetha isikhumbuzo sekota kusiza ukuhlala njengokulindelekile.
Ukudluliselwa Kwamakhadi E-Black Postbank Ngokuningiliziwe

I-SASSA ithatha indawo yekhadi elidala eliqgolide le-SASSA ngelisha elinsundu eklinywa yi-Postbank. Inhloso eshiwoyo ukuthiyela izakhiwo zokukhokha nokuthuthukisa ukuphepha. Abatholi besibonelelo abathatha ngekhadi le-SASSA/Postbank kulindeleke ukuba bashintshe ku-black card e-Postbank noma e-SASSA. I-SASSA ibhekisele isidleke esisemphakathini somhlahlandlela wokudlulisela osuku olungu-31 August 2026 luna ukuba izinkokhelo ziqhubeke zingenaphumuli. Ngenxa yokuthi izinsuku ezisemthenthefu zingashintsha, hlala uqinisekisa usuku lwanje ezishaneleni ezisemthenthefu ze-SASSA neze-Postbank ngaphambi kokuhamba.

Uma usuke uthola i-SRD yakho nge-EFT ekhawuntini yakho yasebhange, ukudluliselwa kwekhadi kungase kungakuthinti nhlobo — indlela yakho yokukhokha ihlala ifana. Ukudluliselwa kubaluleke kakhulu kulabo abathembele ekhadini eliphathekayo le-SASSA/Postbank lokuthatha. Uma ungaqiniseki ukuthi ukwaqembu lini, hlola indlela yakho yokukhokha kuphaneli le-SRD futhi, uma kudingeka, vakashela ihhovisi le-SASSA noma igatsha le-Postbank unomazisi wakho ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi okudingayo ukukwenza.
Intela Nesibonelelo Se-SRD

Inkokhelo ye-SRD R370 iyisibonelelo sokusiza umphakathi futhi ayikhokhiswa intela yokuthola imali. Akudingeki uyimemezele njengemali engenayo ekhokhiswayo embuyisweni wakho wonyaka, futhi ukuyithola akudala isikweletu sentela noma isidingo sokubhalisela intela. Lokhu kufana nokwelashwa kwezinye izibonelelo ze-SASSA. Uma uphinde ubenomsebenzi osemthenthefu kwenye indawo, lolo holomali luwusebenza ihlala ikhokhiswa intela njengokujwayelekile — kuphela ingxenye yesibonelelo engenawo umthwalo wentela.
Ukuvikela I-Akhawunti Yakho Nokuphepha Kwakho

Iphrofayela yakho ye-SRD ibalulekile kwabahlali Beza ngoba ilawula inkokhelo yanyanga zonke. Ivikela ngokugcina i-OTP, i-PIN, ne-Phasiwedi yakho iseMfihlweni — akukho nqubo esemthenthefu ye-SASSA ezoke icela lezi. Sebenzisa inombolo yocingo oyilawulayo, futhi qaphela izihambi 'ezisebenzisekayo' ezikunikeza 'ukulungisa' isicelo sakho; zingase zizame ukuchaza inkokhelo yakho kuma-akhawunti abawalawulayo. Uma usola ukuthi iphrofayela yakho iphazanyiswe, xhumana ne-SASSA Fraud Hotline ku-0800 60 10 11 ngokushesha.

Qaphela kakhulu ngezixhumanisi ozicofayo. Amasayithi obugebengu alinganisa i-srd.sassa.gov.za ukuzokweba umazisi wakho ne-OTP, bese eshintshela imininingwane yakho yasebhange. Hlala ufaka ikheli elisemthenthefu ngqo kubrowser wakho noma usebenzise umugqa osemthenthefu we-WhatsApp 082 046 8553. Uma iwebhusayithi icela i-OTP yakho 'ukukuqinisekisa' ngaphandle kohlelo lokungena olusemthenthefu, yivale. Ukubheka njalo isimo sakho ngephaneli elisemthenthefu yindlela ephephile kakhulu yokuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho okuguquliwe ngaphandle kolwazi lwakho.
Imiphumela Yezikhalazo Nokuthi Ichaza Ukuthini

Ngemva kokuba i-ITSAA icubungule isikhalazo sakho, ingasekela, isekele ngokwengxenye, noma silinqabe. 'Sekeliwe' kusho ukuthi ukwaliwa kwaleyo nyanga kwabuyiselwa emuva futhi kufanele ukhokhelwe kuyo, kuhlanganise nanoma yiyiphi inkokhelo ebuyela emuva okusamelwe kuyo. 'Sinqatshiwe' kusho ukuthi i-Tribunal yavumelana nesinqumo se-SASSA ngokusekelwe ebufakazini, futhi leyo nyanga ngeke ikhokhwe. Inyanga ngayinye okufake isikhalazo ngayo inqunywa ngokwehlukana, ngakho ungawina inyanga eyodwa bese ulahlekelwa ngeminye kuye ngamaqiniso angezansi kwalowo nalowo.

Uma isikhalazo sakho sinqatshiwe futhi ukholelwa ukuthi kwenzeka iphutha leqiniso noma lenqubo (isib., i-SASSA yasebenzisa idatha ye-UIF endala), ungafuna isibuyekezo esengeziwe ngezishaneli ezihlinzekwa yi-ITSAA, kodwa iwindi lokufaka izikhalazo lezinsuku ezingama-30 elijwayelekile lenyanga yasekuqaleni lisasebenza. Isifundo esisebenzayo ukuthi ufake isikhalazo ngokushesha bese unikela ubufakazi obuqine okokuqala, ngoba izixazululo zakamuva ziyaphuza futhi azinakuba namuqiseko. Gcina inombolo yakho Yokubheka Isikhalazo nanoma yiziphi izincwadi zemiphumela kumarekhodi akho.
Izimali Ezibuyela Emuva Ngemva Kwesikhalazo Esiphumelelayo

Lapho isikhalazo sisekelwa ngenyanga okunqatshwe ngokungalungile kuyo, i-SASSA ngokuvamile ikhokha leyo nyanga njengemali ebuyela emuva, ngoba ubukufanelekele therein ngakho konke. Imali ebuyela emuva ilandela indlela efanayo (EFT noma Cash Send) oyikhethile. Ikhokhwa lapho ukubuyiselwa emuva kucutshungulwa, okungathatha amasonto engeziwe ngemva komphumela. Uma isikhalazo esisekeliwe singakhokhwa ngemva kwesikhathi esifanele, landela ngenombolo yokubheka ye-ITSAA futhi, uma kudingeka, ihhovisi le-SASSA — kodwa qaphela ukuthi izinyanga ongazikhalazanga kuzo phakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-30 (noma kuze kube ezingama-90 ngephaneli ye-ITSAA) ngokuvamile zilahleka ngisho noma ubufaneleke ngempela.

Zonke izibuyekezo zimahhala futhi zenziwa ngephaneli elisemthenthefu le-SRD noma ehhovisi le-SASSA — ungaze ukhokhele muntu ukuba akwenzele. contentBlocks.text: I-SRD Nezinye Izinsiza Zikahulumeni

Isibonelelo se-SRD sihamba kanye nolunye usizo lukahulumeni. Sahlukile ku-UIF (olunze ababambe iqhaza abalahlekelwe umsebenzi), ku-NSFAS (uxhaso lwabafundi), nasezibonelweni ezingapheli ze-SASSA. Ukuthola i-SRD akukurejistreyi kwezindlu ze-RDP noma izinhlelo zokusekwa ezihlobene ne-COVID, futhi akuthinti izinhlobo eziningi zezinsiza ezingezona ezesikhwama. Ngenxa yokuthi iminyango ehlukene iqhuba izinhlelo ezehlukene, hlala uqinisekisa ukusebenzisana nomnyango ofanele kunokuba ucabange. Isib., usizo lwamasipala kwabampofu nezinhlelo zokudla ezikoleni zinemithetho yazo futhi azixhunyaniswe nesimo sakho se-SRD.

contentBlocks.text: Kuthiwani Uma Unqatshwa Ngokuphindaphindiwe

Abanye abatholi besibonelelo bayanqatshwa inyanga ngenyanga. Ngaphambi kokucabanga ukuthi uhlelo luphukile, hlola ikhodi yesizathu ngaso sonke isikhathi — iboniswa esimweni sakho. Izimbangela ezijwayelekile ziyafana: amadiphozithi angaphezu kuka-R624, irekhodi le-UIF noma le-NSFAS elisebenzayo, esinye isibonelelo kumazisi wakho, noma ukungafani komazisi okungazange kuxazululwe. Uma isizathu sifana ngenyanga ngayinye, ukulungisa imbangela eyisisekelo (hhayi ukufaka isicelo kabusha) yilokho okushintsha umphumela. Ngezinkinga zokuthola imali, isifungo sichaza amadiphozithi enziwa kanye noma angezona ezemali engenayo; nge-UIF/NSFAS, incwadi yokuqedwa noma yokuqedelela yilokho ukuhlanza uphawu.

Uma uqinisekile ukuthi ukwaliwa akulungile futhi izikhalazo ziyaqhubeka sehluleka, cabanga ukuthi ingabe irekhodi elidala lomsebenzi noma lokuxhaswa lisaphila yini ezinhlelweni ze-SARS, ze-UIF, noma ze-NSFAS. Lawa marekhodi awashintshi ngaso leso sikhathi umsebenzi noma izifundo ziphela, futhi i-SASSA ingasebenza kuphela kulokho lezo zinhlelo ezikubikayo. Ukuxazulula irekhodi lomthombo ngqo nesikhungo esifanele, bese ufaka isikhalazo nobufakazi, ngokuvamile yisona sixazululo esizinzile. Ihhovisi le-SASSA nalo lingacebisa ukuthi ngabe ukubuyekezwa ngesandla kuyafanele yini esimweni sakho.
Ukusebenzisa Kahle Isibonelelo Esishintshashintshayo

Ngenxa yokuthi i-SRD ingagunyazwa ngenyanga bese inqatshiwe kwelinye, kuphephile kakhulu ukuyiphatha njengokwesekwa okwengezile kunokuba ibe imali engenayo eyinhloko. Lapho kungenzeka, gwema ukuzibophezela ku-R370 ezibophweni ezizinzile zanyanga zonke ongakwazi ukuzihlangabezana uma inyanga inqatshiwa. Abatholi abaningi besebenzisa isibonelelo ngezindingo ezibalulekile ezinjengokudla nezokuthutha, futhi bagcina isilinganisi esincane sezinyanga lapho inkokhelo ingafiki. Ukuhlela kwehlukahlukana, kunokuba ucabange ukuthi izofika njalo, kunciphisa umthwalo wezinyanga eziphuthele.

contentBlocks.text: Indlela Yokubona Ukuxhumana Kwangempela Kwe-SASSA

Imilayezo yangempela ye-SASSA ifika njenge-SMS isuka ohlelweni olusemthenthefu futhi iqukethi ukuphakamisa kwakho noma i-voucher, akukaze ibe into ecela ukukhokha noma i-PIN yakho. I-SASSA ngeke ikufonele icela iphasiwedi yasebhange yakho, futhi iyeshele izixhumanisi ezikucela ukuthi ufake i-OTP yakho kusayithi lomuntu wesithathu. Uma umlayezo udala ukuphuthuma — 'isibonelelo sakho siyokhanselwa ngaphandle kokuthi ukhokhe manje' — ngokucishe kube yikho konke ukukhwabanisa. Uma ungaqiniseki, vula i-srd.sassa.gov.za ngqo bese ubheka isimo sakho kunokuba usebenze ngokomlayezo.

contentBlocks.text: Abafundi: Ukubuka Okuningiliziwe

Umthetho wabafundi unembile: uxhaso lwe-NSFAS olusebenzayo luyakwenqaba, kodwa ukuba umfundi akukwenqabi. Umfundi noma umfundi wasenyuvesi ongahambi ku-NSFAS futhi ongenamunye umholo ungafaneleka, inqobo nje uma amadiphozithi ehlala ngu-R624 noma ngaphansi. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abantu abaningi abasha bacabanga ukuthi baxhasiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, noma ngokuphambene nalokho bacabanga ukuthi i-bursary yezinkampani ezizimele ayinakwa. I-bursary ayiyona i-NSFAS, kodwa noma iyiphi imali efaka e-akhawuntini yakho isabalwa ekuhlolweni kwezimali, ngakho amadiphozithi amakhulu evamile e-bursary angase akuphindisele ngenhla komkhawulo ngenyanga ethile.
Abasebenzi Begig Nomani Abasebenza Ngokwesezwekti: Ukubuka Okuningiliziwe

Umsebenzi we-gig nomsebenzi ongakahlelekile usendaweni ephakathi. Isibonelelo asikuvimbeli ukusebenza — sivimbela umholo ongenhla kuka-R624 ngenyanga. Umthumeli wezinto akhokhelwa u-R400 enyangeni ethululekile uyafaneleka; lowo mthumeli akhokhelwa u-R900 enyangeni ematasa uzonqatshwa ngaleyo nyanga. Ngenxa yokuthi ama-platform akhokha ngendlela engavumile ni, isimo sakho sinakho ukushintsha ngenyanga ngenyanga, futhi akusilo iphutha. Ubungozi ukuthi inyanga eyodwa enamandla isusa isibonelelo ngenkathi usadinga kakhulu, ngakho ukulandelela umholo wakho wanyanga zonke kukusiza ubheke phambili bese, uma uphawulwe ngokungalungile, ufake isikhalazo nobufakazi.
Okukhethekile Ngesibonelelo Sengane Kuchaziwe

Umthetho 'isibonelelo esisodwa kuphela' unembangela eyodwa ncamashi: isibonelelo seChild Support Grant esikhokhelwa ingane yakho. Lokhu kugqamile kukhona ngoba isibonelelo sengane senzelwe izidingo zengane, hhayi umholo womnakekeli, ngakho asibalwa njengokusekwa okufanelekile kokusinggcina kumntaka wesibonelelo se-SRD somnakekeli. Zonke ezinye izibonelelo ze-SASSA ezikhokhelwa wena ngqo — Isibonelelo Sokucela Uhilulo, Isibonelelo Sokukhubazeka, Isibonelelo Sengane Yokondliwa — ziyakulandelani. Uma uthola isibonelelo sengane futhi i-SRD yakho inqatshiwa ngesizathu 'usunesinye isibonelelo', lokho kwaliwa okuthile kufanele kusicelwe, ngoba isibonelelo sengane akufanele sisusa sona.
Izikhalazo: Amacebiso Asetshenziswayo Empumelelweni

Imikhuba emithathu ithuthukisa kakhulu imiphumela yezikhalazo. Okokuqala, faka isikhalazo phakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-30 (noma kuze kube ezingama-90 ngephaneli ye-ITSAA) — izikhalazo ezithunyelwa ngemva kwewindi lezinsuku ezingama-90 azicatshangelwa, noma ubufakazi bakho buqine kangakanani. Okwesibili, qhathanisa ubufakazi bakho nesizathu esiqondile sokwaliwa: isifungo semali engenayo, incwadi ye-UIF ye-UIF, incwadi ye-NSFAS ye-NSFAS. Okwesithathu, faka isikhalazo ngenyanga ngayinye enqatshiwe ngokwehlukana kunokuthi ucabange ukuthi isikhalazo esisodwa sibandakanya zonke. Ukugcina ifolda (ephathikali noma ocingweni) enomazisi wakho, izinombolo zokubheka, nezincwadi ezisekelayo kwenza inqubo ibe mshesha ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Ukuqonda Izinsuku Zokukhokha Ze-SRD

Ngokungafani nezibonelelo ezingapheli ze-SASSA, ezivame ukuba nohlelo oluphushiwe olushicilelwe lwezinsuku ezithile zokukhokha zohlelo ngalunye, isibonelelo se-SRD sikhokhwa phakathi kwewindi lanyanga kunezinsuku ezimisiwe ezisodwa. I-SASSA imemezela amalungiselelo okukhokha ezishaneleni zayo ezisemthenthefu, futhi abatholi ngabanye bakhokhelwa ngokuqhubekayo cishe kusukela ngomhla wama-25 futhi ngenyanga kuya usukwini lokugcina. Usuku lwakho olunembile luncike ebankini lakho noma endleleni yakho yokuthatha nase-ndawo okuyo ohlelweni. Phatha iwindi elisukela ngomhla wama-25 kuya ekupheleni kwenyanga njengento eyinhloko enokwethenjwa, futhi thebeleka ezokuxhumana ezisemthenthefu ze-SASSA kuwo wonke amanani athile ahleliwe kunokuba uthembele ekuthunyelweni okungesikho okusemthenthefu kwezinsuku 'ezinembile'.
Indlela I-Cash Send Voucher Esebenza Ngayo

Uma ukhetha i-Cash Send (ukuthatha ezitolo), i-SASSA ithumela i-voucher ye-SMS ocingweni lwakho olubhalisiwe uma inkokhelo isicutshungulwe. Uthatha leyo khodi yevoucher, kanye nomazisi wakho, uye kumdayisi obambe iqhaza — i-Pick n Pay, i-Boxer, i-Shoprite, i-Checkers, noma i-USave — bese uthatha uheshe kwelinye amabhuku. I-voucher iyasetshenziswa kanye kuphela futhi inesikhathi esilinganiselwe, ngakho yithathe ngokushesha futhi ungabelane ngekhodi nanoma ngubani. Uma i-voucher ingafiki ngemva kwenyanga egunyaziwe, bheka isimo sakho nesisiginali socingo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi inombolo yocingo erekhodini isalungile; inombolo engalungile kusho ukuthi i-voucher iya endaweni engalungile.
Ukukhansela Noma Ukuyeka Isibonelelo Ngokuzithandela

Uma izimo zakho zishintsha futhi awusasidi noma awusafaneleki ukuthola isibonelelo — isib., uqala umsebenzi osemthenthefu — kulindeleke ukuthi uyeke ukuthatha, ngoba ukuqhubeka nokuthatha ongafaneleki kungalingana nokukhwabanisa. Ungabuyekeza isimo sakho ngephaneli le-SRD noma ehhovisi le-SASSA, futhi ukuhlolwa kwezimali kwanyanga zonke kuzoyeka noma kanjani ukugunyaza izinyanga ohluleka kuzo. Ukugcina imininingwane yakho inemba ngokuzithandela kungukuzibophezela futhi indlela ehlanzekile yokugwema ukudluliselwa kamva ezinyangeni okungafanele ukuba nazo.
I-SRD, Isikweletu, Nemalimboleko

Isibonelelo se-SRD akusiyo imali engenayo evela emsebenzini futhi akusiyo imalimboleko, ngakho akudala isikweletu noma kuthinte irekhodi lakho lesikweletu. Ababolekisi kungenzeka, kodwa-ke, bakubuze ngomholo wakho uma ufaka isicelo sesikweletu; isibonelelo singabalwa njengomholo, kodwa ngoba siyisikhashana futhi siyashintshashintsha, isibambiso esibuthakathaka esibophweni eside sokubuyisa. Qaphela ukuthatha isikweletu esithatha ukuthi isibonelelo sizofika njalo — inyanga eyodwa enqatshiwe ingakushiya ungenakho ukukhokha. Njengokujwayelekile, isibonelelo kumele siphathwe njengokusekwa okwesikhashana, hhayi njengeholo elingapheli.
Uhlu Lokusheshisa Lokufaneleka

Nginganikeza umazisi/iphasi kanye nenombolo yocingo ngegama lami.

contentBlocks.title: Hlala unolwazi ngemithombo esemthenthefu
contentBlocks.text: Imithetho, imikhawulo, nezinsuku ze-SRD zingashintsha. Ulwazi oluthembekile kakhulu luhlala luvela ku-srd.sassa.gov.za, emugqeni we-WhatsApp we-SASSA 082 046 8553, naku-Tribunal Ezimele (ITSAA) ku-itsaa.gov.za. Sebenzisa lolu hla oluthembekile, kodwa qinisekisa imininingwane ebukhoma eziteshini ezisemthethweni ngaphambi kokuthatha isenzo.
Ababaleki Nomasiza Ngenjongo Yokukhosela: Ukubuka Okuningiliziwe

Ababaleki abavamile nabafuna ukukhosela/abanama-permit akhethekile bafanelekela isibonelelo se-SRD, kodwa isicelo sisebenzisa inombolo yabo yephasi noma yokufuna ukukhosela esikhundleni somazisi waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlolwa kwezimali okufanayo nezinsizakalo zemali engenayo nolunye usizo kusasebenza. Inkinga evame kakhulu kuleli qembu iphasi eliphelelwe isikhathi noma elilindelwe, ngoba i-SASSA iqinisekisa inombolo ngokuqhathanisa nohlelo lwe-Home Affairs; uma iphasi lingasebenzi kulelo hlelo, ukuqinisekiswa kwehluleka. Ukugcina iphasi lakho livumelekile futhi libuyekeziwe ne-Home Affairs kubalulekile ngakho, futhi noma yisiphi igebe esimweni sephasi lingahumushela ngqo enyangeni ehlulekile noma ephelile.
I-SRD Nabantu Abakhubazekile

Uma ukhubazekile futhi uneminyaka ephakathi kuka-18 no-59 ungenamali engenayo noma unayo encane kakhulu, isibonelelo se-SRD singasiza esikhathini esifushane, kodwa asisiyo indawo yokuthutha okusemthenthefu Isibonelelo Sokukhubazeka (Disability Grant), esikhokha inani eliphakeme futhi ngeke sibuyekezwa kwanyanga zonke ngendlela efanayo. Uma ukukhubazeka kukuvimbela ukusebenza, kufanele uhlole iDisability Grant ngehhovisi le-SASSA nangokuhlolwa kwezokwelapha. Awukwazi ukuthola kokubili iDisability Grant ne-SRD ngesikhathi sinye, ngakho ukufaneleka okungcono kakhulu esikhathini eside ngokuvamile isibonelelo esingapheli kunokuba i-SRD yesikhashana.
Ukuthatha Isikhathi Esingakanani Ukuze Izimali Zibonakale

Uma inyanga ibonisa 'Kwenziwa Inkokhelo' noma 'Isemukelwe', imali ngokuvamile ibonakala phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-1 kuya kwezi-3 zokusebenza, kuye ngejubane lokuqhubeka kwebhange lakho. Ama-vouchers wokuthatha ezitolo e-Cash Send ngokuvamile ayatholakala ngokushesha lapho i-SMS ifika. Uma kudlula izinsuku ezimbalwa zokusebenza kungafiki mali futhi imininingwane yakho ilungile, inkokhelo ingase ibuyile emuva — hlola kabusha imininingwane yakho yasebhange futhi, uma kudingeka, buyekeza ngenyanga elandelayo. Ukungatholi inkokhelo okuqhubekayo ngencazelo elungile kufanele kuphakanyiswe ne-SASSA usebenzisa inombolo yakho yokubheka, kodwa ukubambezeleka okuningi kuxazululeka ngaphakathi kwewindi elijwayelekile ngaphandle kokungenelela.

contentBlocks.text: Ukuhlanganisa Konke

Isibonelelo se-SRD R370 uhlobo olunamandla kodwa olunemibandela eqinile kakhulu losizo. Impumelelo ivela emikhubeni emithathu: faka isicelo kanye ngemininingwane enembile, bheka isimo sakho njalo ngenyanga, bese ufaka isikhalazo phakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-30 (noma kuze kube ezingama-90 ngephaneli ye-ITSAA) uma inyanga inqatshiwe ngokungalungile. Gcina imininingwane yakho yocingo neyasebhange isesikhathini, phatha isibonelelo njengento eshintshashintshayo kunokuba iyinto engapheli, futhi uzivikele emikhubeni eqondise kubatholi besibonelelo. Ngale mikhuba, uhlelo lusebenza njengoba kuhlosiwe — ukufaka u-R370 ngenyanga ezandleni zabantu abangenamunye umholo ngempela. Ukuze uthole izinsuku ezisesha, izimo, nezikhalazo, hlala ubuyela kuphaneli elisemthenthefu srd.sassa.gov.za.
Ukuthola Usizo Lapho Uhlelo Kulukhuni Ukulusebenzisa

Akusibo wonke umuntu onendawo ehlelekile yokusebenza, idatha ethembekile, noma ukuzethemba kokuzulazula phaneli loku-inthanethi, futhi i-SASSA iyakuqaphela lokhu. Usizo lwamahhala luyatholakala ngamahhovisi e-SASSA namakiosk okuzisiza, lapho abasebenzi bekusiza khona ukufaka isicelo, ukubheka isimo, nokufaka izikhalazo ngaphandle kwezindleko. Abasebenzi bomphakathi namanxusa amanye amahhovisi omkhandlu nabo baqhuba amaphoyinti okusekwa. Into ebalulekile okuyoyikhumbula ukuthi usizo kufanele luhlale lumahhala — uma umuntu efuna imali yokukusiza, akangeni komthetho. Umhlahlandlela wethu obhekele i-SRD help uhlanganisa izikhonkco zocingo nama-kiosk ngemininingwane eyengeziwe kulabo abathanda usizo lwabantu.

contentBlocks.title: Awuwedwa
contentBlocks.text: Izigidi zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika zithembele esibonelelweni se-SRD. Uma into ingehla kahle — inyanga enqatshiwe, inkokhelo ephuthele noma okumangazayo — ngokuvamile kuyalungiseka ngezinyathelo ezikulo mhlahlandlela: bheka isizathu, buyekeza imininingwane yakho, bese ufaka isikhalazo phakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-30 (noma kuze kube ezingama-90 ngephaneli ye-ITSAA) usebenzisa ubufakazi obufanele.
