faqs.question: Isibonelelo se-SRD sihlala isikhathi esingakanani?
faqs.answer: Isibonelelo se-SRD sinwetshiwe kuze kube okungenani ngoMashi 2027. Siyabuyekezwa unyaka nonyaka nguhulumeni futhi singase sinwetshwe ngokwengeziwe.

faqs.question: Kungani isimo sami se-SRD sithi 'Umthombo Wemali Ongomunye'?
faqs.answer: Lokhu kusho ukuthi i-SASSA ithole idiphozithi yasebhange noma ukubhaliswa ngegama lakho okubonisa ukuthi uneminye imali engenayo. Ngisho isipho esivela emndenini singakwenza. Faka isikhalazo ngesifungo esibhaliwe esichaza idiphozithi ngayinye.

faqs.question: Ngingathola yini isibonelelo se-SRD uma ngisebenza isikhathi esithile?
faqs.answer: Kuphela uma umholo wakho wanyanga zonke ungaphansi kuka-R624. Uma i-akhawunti yakho yasebhange ibonisa amadiphozithi angaphezu kuka-R624 nganoma iyiphi inyanga, uzonqatshwa ngaleyo nyanga.

faqs.question: Ingabe kumele ngifake isicelo kabusha njalo ngenyanga?
faqs.answer: Cha. Uma isicelo sakho sesemukelwe, i-SASSA ikuhlola ngokuzenzakalelayo njalo ngenyanga. Akudingeki ufane ufake isicelo kabusha ngaphandle uma isibonelelo sakho sikhanseliwe.

faqs.question: Ngingathola yini kokubili i-SRD nesinye isibonelelo se-SASSA?
faqs.answer: Cha. Ungathola isibonelelo esisodwa kuphela ngesikhathi. Uma ufanelekela Isibonelelo Sokucela Uhilulo, Isibonelelo Sokukhubazeka, noma Isibonelelo Sengane, kumele ukhethe eysisodwa.

faqs.question: Kuthiwani uma ngigcwalisa iminyaka engu-60 ngenkathi ngithola i-SRD?
faqs.answer: Isibonelelo se-SRD senzelwe iminyaka ephakathi kuka-18 no-59. Uma usugcwalise iminyaka engu-60, kumele ufake isicelo se-Older Person Grant esikhundleni. Vakashela ihhovisi eliseduze le-SASSA ukuze udlulele khona.

faqs.question: Ngiyishintsha kanjani indlela yami yokukhokha ukusuka ebankini ngiye ku-Cash Send?
faqs.answer: Ngena kuphaneli le-SRD eli ku-srd.sassa.gov.za, iya esigabeni 'Indlela Yokukhokha', bese ushintsha usuka ku-'Ukudluliswa Kwemali Kwasebhange' uye ku-'Cash Send'. Ushintsho lusebenza kusukela ngenyanga elandelayo.

faqs.question: Ngingayishintsha yini inombolo yami yocingo ye-SRD?
faqs.answer: Yebo. Ngena kuphaneli le-SRD bese uya esigabeni 'Buyekeza Imininingwane Yomuntu'. Uzodinga ukufinyelela kwinombolo yakho endala ukuze uqinisekise, noma vakashela ihhovisi le-SASSA uma ungasenakho ukufinyelela.

faqs.question: Kuthiwani uma isimo sami se-SRD sithi 'Udliwelelwe'?
faqs.answer: Lokhu kusho ukuthi isicelo sakho samakwa ukuze kuphenywe ukwehlisiwa ngenkohliso. Xhumana ne-SASSA Fraud Hotline ku-0800 60 10 11 bese ulungiselela ukuvakashela ihhovisi le-SASSA unomazisi wakho ukuze kuxazululwe.

faqs.question: Ingabe isibonelelo se-SRD sikhokhiswa intela?
faqs.answer: Cha. Izibonelelo ezenhlalakahle ze-SASSA azikhokhiswa intela yokuthola imali. Akudingeki uzimemezele encwadini yakho yentela.

faqs.question: Isimo sami 'Kusacutshungulwa' isingaphezu kwamasonto amabili. Kumele ngenzeni?
faqs.answer: Isimo 'Kusacutshungulwa' kusho ukuthi isicelo sakho sisadlula enqubweni yokuqinisekisa ngokuqhathanisa ne-Home Affairs, i-SARS, i-UIF, ne-NSFAS. Ukubambezeleka okufushane kujwayelekile. Qhubeka ubheka njalo ngezinsuku ezimbalwa. Uma ihlala 'Kusacutshungulwa' isikhathi eside ngokungavamile (amasonto ambalwa) ngaphandle kokuthuthukiswa, ungaxhumana neziko lezingcingo le-SASSA noma uvakashele ihhovisi unomazisi nenombolo yakho yokubheka.

faqs.question: Isimo sami sithi 'Isemukelwe' kodwa angikakhokhelwa. Kungani?
faqs.answer: Ukusemukelwa kusho ukuthi ufanelekele leyo nyanga; inkokhelo ilandela ewindini lokukhokha elijwayelekile (cishe kusukela ngomhla wama-25 kuya ekupheleni kwenyanga). Uma iwindi selidlulile futhi usemukelwe, qala uqinisekise ukuthi indlela yakho yokukhokha nemininingwane yasebhange ilungile futhi ingeyakho. I-akhawunti engalungile noma evaliwe ingenza inkokhelo ibuye emuva. Uma imininingwane ilungile futhi inkokhelo still ingakafiki, bheka isimo kabusha bese uxhumana ne-SASSA, unenombolo yakho yokubheka.

faqs.question: Ingabe umholo womakhelwane warnke wengane yami noma wowesifazane wami uthinta isibonelelo sami se-SRD?
faqs.answer: Ukuhlolwa kwezimali kubheka imali engenayo e-akhawuntini YAKHO yasebhange namarekhodi akho siqu kahulumeni, hhayi ngokuzenzakalelayo ungeni lowo womlingani wakho. Kodwa-ke, uma imali evela kumlingani wezakho ifakwa njalo e-akhawuntini yakho bese ikhuphulela inani lesewele yenyanga ngaphezu kuka-R624, lokho kungathinta ukuhlolwa kwakho. Isibonelelo sisekelwe esimweni sakho sakho sezimali njengoba kukhonjiswa ekhawuntini yakho nasezizindalwazini.

faqs.question: Ngafaka isicelo kabili ngephutha. Ingabe lokho yinkinga?
faqs.answer: Ukuthumela izicelo ezingaphezu kweyodwa ngomazisi ofanayo akudali izibonelelo eziningi futhi ngokuvamile kuyahlanganiswa, kodwa ukuphinda izicelo kungadala ukudideka noma ukubambezeleka. Sebenzisa inombolo yakho yokubheka yokuqala ukubheka isimo, futhi ungamukhokhi muntu ukuze 'alungise' izinto eziphindwe kabili. Uma ukhathazekile, xhumana ne-SASSA unomazisi wakho ukuze uqinisekise isicelo sakho esisodwa esisebenzayo.

faqs.question: Ngiyiguqula kanjani imininingwane yami yasebhange esibonelelweni se-SRD?
faqs.answer: Ngena kuphaneli le-SRD eli ku-srd.sassa.gov.za, iya esigabeni sokubuyekeza imininingwane yomuntu noma yasebhange, bese ufaka i-akhawunti yakho entsha (kumele ibe ngeyakho). Ushintsho ngokuvamile lusebenza kusukela ngenyanga elandelayo. Ungasebenzisa futhi umugqa we-WhatsApp noma uvakashele ihhovisi le-SASSA uma ungakwazi ukufinyelela kuphaneli. Ukuze uthole umhlahlandlela ophelele bheka ikhasi lethu lezindlela zokukhokha.

faqs.question: Kuthiwana ngemva kokuthumela isikhalazo?
faqs.answer: Isikhalazo sakho siya ku-Independent Tribunal for Social Assistance Appeals (ITSAA), esibuyekeza ubufakazi ngokuqhathanisa nesinqumo se-SASSA saleyo nyanga ethile. Imiphumela: kusekeliwe (ugunyazwa ngaleyo nyanga, ngenkokhelo ebuyela emuva uma ifaneleka), kusekelwe ngengxenye, noma kwenqatshiwe. I-ITSAA iyakwazisa, futhi inqubo ingathatha amasonto ambalwa. Gcina inombolo yakho Yokubheka Isikhalazo ukuze ulandele.

faqs.question: Kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani isikhalazo se-SRD?
faqs.answer: Izikhathi zokuguqulwa kwezikhalazo ziyahluka, kodwa eziningi zixazululeka phakathi kwamasonto ambalwa kuya ezinyangeni ezimbili kuye ngenani ngebufakazi bakho. Akukho umphumela osheshayo. Bheka isimo sesikhalazo sakho usebenzisa inombolo yakho yokubheka nezishaneli ezisemthenthefu ze-ITSAA kunokuba uthembele abesithathu.

faqs.question: Ngiwuphuthele umkhawulo wezinsuku ezingama-30 wokufaka isikhalazo. Ngisengafaka yini isikhalazo?
faqs.answer: Iwindi lezinsuku ezingama-30 liqinile futhi libalwa kusukela ngosuku lwenyanga enqatshiwe. Ukuwulokhu ukuphuthela ngokuvamile kusho ukuthi leyo nyanga akukwazi ukuphinde icatshangelwe ngesikhalazo esijwayelekile. Ukulungiswa okusebenzayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinyanga ezizayo zihlolwa ngokufanele; uma ukholelwa ukuthi kwenzeka iphutha lohlelo noma lenqubo, xhumana ne-ITSAA noma ne-SASSA ukuze uthole isiqondiso ngezinketho zakho.

faqs.question: Ngingathola yini isibonelelo se-SRD ne-UIF ngesikhathi sinye?
faqs.answer: Cha. Ukuthola izinkokhelo ze-UIF kuyimali engenayo enqikaza ukufaneleka kwesibonelelo se-SRD. Uma uku-UIF, izinyanga zakho ze-SRD zizonqatshwa. Uma i-UIF yakho iyaphela, lezo zinyanga zakamuva zingafaneleka, futhi ungafaka isikhalazo nganoma iyiphi inyanga enqatshiwe ngokungalungile ngemva kokuba i-UIF iyekile ngokuthumela incwadi yakho yokuyekiswa.

faqs.question: Kusho ukuthini 'Ukuqinisekiswa Komazisi Kwehlulekile'?
faqs.answer: Kusho ukuthi imininingwane oyithumelele ayifani namarekhodi oMnyango Wezindaba Zangaphakathi — ngokuvamile ukungafani kwesibongo, usuku lokuzalwa, noma inombolo yomazisi. Kuxazulule ngokuqedela isinyathelo sokuqinisekiswa kobuso kuphaneli le-SRD noma ngokulungisa imininingwane yakho e-Home Affairs, bese uhlola kabusha isimo sakho. Ukusebenzisa igama eliqondile kumazisi wakho ekufakeni isicelo kuvimbela lokhu.

faqs.question: Ngingasebenzisa yini i-akhawunti yasebhange yelungu lomkhaya ukuthola inkokhelo?
faqs.answer: Cha. I-akhawunti yasebhange esetshenziselwa inkokhelo ye-SRD kumele ibe ngeyakho. Izinkokhelo ezikumwa-akhawunti ezingafani nomazisi wakho ziyenqatshwa noma zimakwe, okungabambezela noma kuvimbe isibonelelo sakho futhi kungavusa ukukhathazeka ngokukhwabanisa. Sebenzisa i-akhawunti yakho, noma khetha i-Cash Send yokuthatha ezitolo uma ungenayo i-akhawunti.

faqs.question: Inombolo yami yocingo yalahleka noma ishintshwe (SIM swap). Ngiyigcina kanjani isibonelelo sami?
faqs.answer: Inombolo yakho ebhalisiwe isetshenziselwa ama-OTP nama-SMS wezimo, ngakho yibuyekeze ngokushesha. Uma usenokufinyelela, yishintshe kuphaneli le-SRD. Uma usulahlekelwe ukufinyelela, vakashela ihhovisi le-SASSA nomazisi wakho ukuze uqinisekise umazisi wakho bese ubuyekeza inombolo. Ukwenza ngokushesha kuvimbela ukudelulwa kwezokuxhumana nenkokhelo.

faqs.question: Ingabe ukuthola isibonelelo se-SRD kuthinta isikolo sami sesikweletu?
faqs.answer: Cha. Isibonelelo se-SRD inkokhelo yokusiza umphakathi, ayikona isikweletu noma ikhredithi. Ukuyithola akudali irekhodi lesikweletu noma kuthinte isikolo sakho sesikweletu. Ayibhekwa nayo njengemali engenayo okumelwe uyibuyise.

faqs.question: Ingabe isibonelelo se-SRD sikhokhiswa intela?
faqs.answer: Cha. Njengezinye izibonelelo ezenhlalakahle ze-SASSA, inkokhelo ye-SRD R370 ayikhokhiswa intela futhi akudingeki imemezelwe njengemali engenayo ekhokhiswayo embuyisweni wakho.

faqs.question: Ingabe abafuna ukukhosela nababaleki bangafaka isicelo se-SRD?
faqs.answer: Yebo. Ababaleki abamukelwe ababhaliswe ohlelweni lwe-Home Affairs kanye nabafuna ukukhosela noma abanama-permit akhethekile bangafaka isicelo. Basebenzisa inombolo yabo yephasi noma yokufuna ukukhosela esikhundleni somazisi waseNingizimu Afrika, futhi kumele bahlangabezane nokuhlolwa kwezimali nokunye ukufaneleka okufanayo.

faqs.question: Ngingumfundi ongaxhasiwe yi-NSFAS. Ngingayithola yini i-SRD?
faqs.answer: Ungafaneleka uma ungenamunye umholo futhi amadiphozithi akho anyanga zonke ehlala ngu-R624 noma ngaphansi. Ukungatholi i-NSFAS ngokwayo akwanele — ukuhlolwa kwemali engenayo kusasebenza kunoma yini efikayo ekhawuntini yakho. Ama-bursary azimele nokusekwa komndeni kusabalwa njengamadiphozithi abalwa kulokho okungaphezu komkhawulo.

faqs.question: Ingabe abasebenzi basekhaya nabagig workers bangathola isibonelelo se-SRD?
faqs.answer: Kuphela uma inani eliphelele abalithola ngenyanga lingaphansi kuka-R624 noma lingalingana futhi ungasebenzi ngokusemthenthefu nge-PAYE. Imali engenayo ye-gig nesezingameko ihlolwa ngokwalokho okufika ebankini lakho ngenyanga, ngakho isimo sakho singashintsha kusukela kwelinye inyanga kuye kwelinye. Uma ukhokhelwa ngokusemthenthefu nge-PAYE, ngokuvamile uthathwa njengosebenza futhi ngeke ufanelekele.

faqs.question: Ngiyazi kanjani ukuthi isibonelelo sami selile (lapsed)?
faqs.answer: Bheka isimo sakho njalo ngenyanga. Uma inyanga ibonisa 'Sinqatshiwe' (isib., 'Umthombo Wemali Ongomunye') noma umane ungatholi inkokhelo nangemva kokugunyazwa ngaphambilini, isibonelelo selile kuleyo nyanga ngenxa yokuhlolwa kwezimali noma uphawu lwedatha. Lungisa imbangela eyisisekelo bese ufaka isikhalazo ngezinyanga ezinqatshiwe ngokungalungile phakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-30 (noma kuze kube ezingama-90 ngephaneli ye-ITSAA).

faqs.question: Iyini i-black Postbank card, futhi ngiyayidinga yini?
faqs.answer: I-SASSA ithatha indawo yekhadi elidala eliqgolide le-SASSA ngekhadi elisha elimnyama le-Postbank. I-SASSA ishiye umhlahlandlela wokudlulisela osuku olungu-31 August 2026 lokuba abatholi besibonelelo bashintshe amakhadi abo e-Postbank noma e-SASSA ukuze baqhubeke nokuthola izinkokhelo. Uma uthola inkokhelo nge-EFT ekhawuntini yakho yasebhange, lokhu kungase kungakuthinti; uma uthatha ngekhadi le-SASSA/Postbank, qinisekisa isimo sakho ezishaneleni ezisemthenthefu, ngoba izinsuku zingashintsha.

faqs.question: Ngingafaka kabusha isicelo ngemva kokukhansela i-SRD yami?
faqs.answer: Uma isibonelelo sakho sikhanseliwe (isib., ngemva kokungafaneleki isikhathi eside), ngokuvamile kudingeka uthumele isicelo esisha kunokuba usicindezele kabusha. Uma bekumiswe nje noma kwaliwe ngezinyanga ezithile, lezo zinyanga zingase zilungiseke ngezibuyekezo nezikhalazo. Vakashela iphaneli le-SRD noma ihhovisi le-SASSA ukuze uthole unamandla ngokwesimo sakho.

faqs.question: Kungani kufanele ngiziqinisekise kabusha njalo ngezinyanga ezintathu?
faqs.answer: I-SASSA idinga ukuqinisekiswa kabusha ngezikhathi ezithile (cishe njalo ngezinyanga ezintathu) ukuze iqinisekise imininingwane yakho nokuzidinga okuqhubekayo, kanye nokuhlolwa kwanyanga zonke okwenziwa kabusha. Kuwumkhawulo wokuqinisekisa ukuthi isibonelelo siya kubantu abasahlangabezana nezidingo. Ziqinisekise kabusha ngephaneli elisemthenthefu lapho ucelwa; ukuyiphutha kungashiya irekhodi lakho lidala futhi kuthinte izinkokhelo.

faqs.question: Ingabe isibonelelo se-SRD sibalwa kwezindlu ze-RDP noma kwezinye izinzuzo zenhlalakahle?
faqs.answer: Isibonelelo se-SRD imali ekhokhwayo yesikhashana yokusiza futhi ngokuvamile ayithathwa njengemali engenayo engapheli yezinye izinhlelo zenhlalakahle, kodwa imithetho yezindlu nezinye izinzuzo ibekwa yiminyango ehlukene kahulumeni. Ukuze uthole izimpendulo eziqondile ngendlela isibonelelo esihlangana ngayo nezindlu ze-RDP noma olunye usizo, xhumana nomnyango ofanele noma ihhovisi le-SASSA, futhi uthembele eziqondiweni ezisemthenthefu kunokuba uthole izeluleko ezingakahlelekile.

faqs.question: Ngingathola yini i-SRD uma sengivele ngithola iChild Support Grant yengane yami?
faqs.answer: Yebo. Isibonelelo seChild Support Grant esikhokhelwa ingane yakho yiwona okukodwa okukhethekile emthethweni 'akukho esinye isibonelelo'. Ungathola isibonelelo sengane leyo kanye ne-SRD R370 yakho ngesikhathi sinye, inqobo nje uma uhlangabezana nazo zonke izidingo ze-SRD (iminyaka ephakathi kuka-18 no-59, umholo ungu-R624 noma ngaphansi, akukho i-UIF/NSFAS, njll.).

faqs.question: Ngingathola kuphi usizo lwabantu uma uhlelo loku-inthanethi kulukhuni ukulusebenzisa?
faqs.answer: Ungafaka isicelo noma uthole usizo ehhovisi le-SASSA noma ngezinkonzo zocingo zamahhala ze-SASSA namakiosk okuzisiza, lapho abasebenzi bekusiza khona ngaphandle kwezindleko. Qaphela noma ngubani okhokhisayo. Umhlahlandlela wethu we-SRD help uchaza indlela yokufinyelela usizo lwabantu, futhi ikhasi lokubheka isimo lichaza ukubheka nge-USSD nange-WhatsApp.

faqs.question: Ngiyibika kanjani imikhuba noma ukukhwabanisa kwe-SRD?
faqs.answer: Bika imikhuba nokukhwabanisa ku-SASSA Fraud Hotline ku-0800 60 10 11, futhi ungabelane nge-PIN yakho, iphasiwedi, noma i-OTP. Sebenzisa izishaneli ezisemthenthefu kuphela: i-srd.sassa.gov.za, umugqa we-WhatsApp 082 046 8553, noma ihhovisi le-SASSA eliphathekile.
